jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Cloud Consultant (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Consulting

suchen wir dich zum  nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
als Senior Full-Stack Cloud Consultant (w/m/d).

Das erwartet dich

Entwicklung
– Du entwirfst und entwickelst Full-Stack-Anwendungen auf Cloud-Plattformen und erstellst Backend-Dienste und APIs. Darüber hinaus entwickelst du Frontend-Schnittstellen unter Verwendung moderner Frameworks.
Integration
 – Du integrierst Anwendungen mit Cloud-nativen Diensten (Storage, Messaging, Identity) und unterstützt CI/CD-Bereitstellungspipelines. Darüber hinaus verantwortest du die Fehlerbehebung und optimierst Anwendungsleistungen.
Zusammenarbeit
– Als Senior Full-Stack-Consultant arbeitest du eng mit DevOps-, Migrations- und Plattform-Teams zusammen.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast dein Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
Du bringst 3–6 Jahre Erfahrung in der Full-Stack-Entwicklung mit.
Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung mit Frontend (React, Angular oder Vue) und Backend-Frameworks (Node.js, .NET Core, Java oder Python) sowie Cloud-Plattformen (AWS, Azure oder GCP) und Datenbanken (SQL und/oder NoSQL).
Du hast Erfahrung mit Git, CI/CD-Pipelines sowie mit Microservices oder Cloud-nativen Architekturen.
Vorerfahrung im Entwerfen und das Implementieren von REST-APIs sowie Kenntnisse im Bereich Containerisierung (Docker) runden dein Profil ab.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität
– In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten. 
Masterförderung
– Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Darüber hinaus bieten wir die Möglichkeit einer Masterförderung für Examensmaster und Spezialisierungsmaster an.  
Freizeit
– Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung.  Gesundheit
– Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von einer vergünstigten Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft. 
Das ist noch nicht alles
– Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.    
Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Cloud Teams verknüpfst du Technologien und Businessperspektiven, um unsere Kunden bei allen wichtigen Fragen entlang ihrer Cloud-Transformations-Journey zu unterstützen. Mithilfe unseres umfassenden Fachwissens im Cloud-Bereich und zertifizierten Cloud-Expert:innen für Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS) und Google Cloud Platform (GCP) identifizieren wir gemeinsam mit dir im Team und mit unseren Kunden die beste Cloud-Lösung und -Strategie. Unterstütze uns dabei, die Wachstumspotenziale unserer Mandanten in der digitalen Welt zu nutzen!

 unter +49 211 981-5510
.

jobs.description:
Your mission

As an App Developer (Flutter & C#)
at NeuroNation, you will play a central role in our mobile technology transition. You’ll help shape the future of our platform by building new features with Flutter, maintaining existing systems in C#, and contributing to an engaging, smooth user experience for millions of users worldwide. This is a chance to combine technical expertise with purpose-driven work that improves lives.

Key Responsibilities

Build and maintain mobile app features using Flutter and C#
Drive our mobile technology transition with your Flutter expertise
Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to deliver seamless solutions
Monitor app health and performance to ensure reliability and user satisfaction
Contribute ideas and improvements that reach millions of users

Your profile

Must-have Skills

Proven experience in Flutter mobile development
Strong knowledge of C# and object-oriented programming
Experience developing games with complex logic (e.g., state machines, deep rule sets, dynamic gameplay mechanics)
3+ years of professional experience in software development
Degree in Computer Science or related field
Located in Germany (remote within Germany or hybrid in Berlin)

﻿﻿

Nice-to-Have Skills

Familiarity with Xamarin.Android or Xamarin.iOS
Background in Unity or game development
Experience with quality management systems (e.g., ISO 13485, MDR)

Why us?

Work on something that truly creates value for people
Make a significant impact on a platform used by millions worldwide
Take on meaningful, exciting projects instead of routine corporate or agency work
Help revolutionize health and education systems through technology and innovation
Enjoy flexible working hours (core hours: 9:30–16:30 CET)
Receive a BVG ticket to support sustainable and convenient commuting
Access an Urban Sports Club membership for your well-being and work-life balance
Be part of an open, supportive culture that values learning, growth, and collaboration

About Us

For 15 years, we have been developing digital training programs that are proven to enhance cognitive performance and are easily accessible to people worldwide. Today, our health app NeuroNation
is available in 13 different languages and is used by over 30 million people. Our cognitive therapy program, NeuroNation MED
, has been permanently approved as a digital health application by the Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices and supports approximately one-quarter of all patients with mild cognitive impairment (ICD-10 F06.7) in Germany. Our long-term goal is to establish the first virtual clinic for cognitive and mental health.

Why You Should Join NeuroNation

We build science-backed brain-training and digital cognitive therapy that reaches millions of people. Your work here will shape how people care for their minds every day.

Impactful Work:
Working with us means contributing to a product that profoundly impacts cognitive health. Our brain training programs, backed by cutting-edge neuroscience and cognitive psychology, are designed to enhance cognitive functions, improve working memory, and elevate our users' quality of life.

Inspiring Environment:
At NeuroNation, you'll join a vibrant team of passionate and innovative professionals. We believe that collaboration and creativity thrive in a fun and inclusive environment. From team-building activities to spontaneous brainstorming sessions, we make sure that work is both productive and enjoyable.

Flexible hours:
Our flexible working hours and remote work policy let you tailor your work schedule to fit your lifestyle, ensuring you can perform at your best.

As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values join us and start your #Redcareer today.

About the role:

Join our ERP Engineering team and play a key role in evolving the financial backbone of Europe’s leading e-pharmacy. Working alongside Solution Architects, Functional Consultants and Product teams, you'll build scalable Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance solutions that support critical finance processes while driving innovation, automation and continuous improvement across our ERP landscape.

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O), X++, Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, Lifecycle Services (LCS), General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash & Bank Management, SQL Server, T-SQL, Electronic Reporting (ER), SSRS Reporting, Data Management Framework (DMF), OData Services, REST APIs, Business Events, Dual-write, Power Apps, Power Automate, Git, CI/CD Pipelines.

Design and develop scalable Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance solutions that support our core finance processes, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets and Cash & Bank Management.
Build custom integrations, services, Data Entities, workflows and business events, enabling seamless connectivity across our enterprise systems and supporting business growth.
Drive continuous improvement by developing high-quality reports, Electronic Reporting (ER) solutions and automated financial processes while optimising system performance.
Champion engineering excellence through code reviews, mentoring, CI/CD, release management and the application of Microsoft development best practices.
Partner with Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, Business Analysts, QA Engineers and business stakeholders throughout the full software development lifecycle, from solution design through to production deployment.

Qualifications

jobs.title: Werkstudent / Praktikant (m/w/d) Agentic Software Development & AI Tools
jobs.description:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit zählen wir zu den führenden Herstellern von Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren entwickeln wir Lösungen für die Beschichtung von Architekturglas, Brillengläsern und optischen Komponenten – etwa für Smartphones, Autos und die Medizintechnik.

Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten (m/w/d), der unser Team in Alzenau bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Softwareplattform unterstützt. Dich erwarten spannende Aufgaben in der Softwareentwicklung, im Agentic Coding und bei KI-Anwendungen. Bring deine Ideen ein, übernimm eigene Teilprojekte und werde Teil der Bühler Alzenau GmbH!

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.

Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.

Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

Hier werden Sie brillieren

Du entwickelst unsere Plattform mit C#, Angular und SQL weiter und übernimmst eigene Teilprojekte.
Du nutzt Agentic-Coding-Tools wie Codex, Claude Code oder GitHub Copilot als festen Bestandteil deiner Entwicklungsarbeit.
Du entwickelst Web-Anwendungen, Dashboards und Automatisierungslösungen innerhalb der Plattform.
Du unterstützt bei weiteren AI-Lösungen, beispielsweise AI Agents und LLM-basierten Anwendungen für interne Nutzer.
Du testest, optimierst und dokumentierst Anwendungen.
Du arbeitest mit der IT und den Fachbereichen zusammen, um technische Anforderungen umzusetzen.

Das sind die erforderlichen Fähigkeiten

Du studierst Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder eine vergleichbare technische Fachrichtung.
Du hast Programmierkenntnisse in C# und/oder TypeScript bzw. JavaScript sowie in SQL.

Our Story

Hello there. We’re Zopa.

We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com !

We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces.

If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

The Engineering Challenge

Our Software Engineers don't just write code, they solve real financial problems for millions of customers. You'll work on distributed systems processing thousands of transactions daily, build resilient services that handle people's money, and create experiences that make traditionally complex financial products feel simple.

We care deeply about great engineering, which is why our core stack is Kotlin, running on a modern platform with Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker and AWS Aurora Postgres. But great engineers aren’t defined by a single language which is why we are agnostic with our hiring.

We want the right people, not the 'right' language, so if you come from a C#/.NET background, bring solid fundamentals, and have an appetite for learning something new, we’ll invest in you, help you grow your skills and confidently step into our Kotlin ecosystem.

Your Impact

Writing clean, reliable and maintainable backend code using Kotlin
Working on scalable cloud-based systems within a product-focused Agile team
Collaborating with engineers, product managers and designers to build and ship features
Taking part in planning, technical discussions and code reviews
Building well-tested services and contributing to continuous delivery
Taking ownership of your work — from development to production
Continuously learning and developing your skills in a supportive environment

Your Toolkit

You’ve got some solid hands-on experience with C# but open to learning Java or Kotlin
You care about writing good quality code and value clean design and testing
You’re curious, eager to learn and not afraid to ask questions
You enjoy solving problems and working as part of a collaborative team
You want to build things that have a real impact on customers
You communicate clearly and are happy contributing to team decisions
You’re excited by modern engineering practices like CI/CD and cloud-native tools

Our Engineering Culture

Customer impact over unnecessary complexity
Team success over individual heroics
Operational ownership, not just feature delivery
Continuous improvement through honest feedback

Added Bonus

Experience with fintech or banking is a plus, but we value problem-solvers from all backgrounds

#ON-LI1

At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our Manchester office 2-3 days a week. (WeWork, Dalton Place, 29 John Dalton Street, M2 6WF) Please note this office is dog friendly so you might see some furry friends about!

You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

Diversity Statement

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030 , we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

Behavioural and competency-based interviews
: please don't use AI . These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

Technical interviews:
it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA Instruments™ is our instrumentation division, which designs advanced metrology and inspection instruments used in both R&D and production across industries and academia. Our tools—ranging from optical profilers and nano-indenters to thin film and defect inspection systems—enable precise surface and material analysis. We partner closely with customers to enable R&D, improve yield, optimize processes, and reduce production costs through innovative hardware, software and application expertise.

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

As a Software Engineering Manager on this team, you will lead and grow a multidisciplinary group of software and firmware engineers who design, develop, release, and support our families of surface profiler, thin film, sheet resistance and nanoindentation measurement instruments. You will be responsible for both people leadership and technical direction spanning embedded firmware, Windows desktop applications, software architecture, and measurement and data-analysis algorithms, leveraging cutting-edge technologies and the latest advancements in software engineering and AI/ML/DL. jobs.description:
Why Faculty?

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About The Team

Our Defence team is focused on building and embedding human-centered AI solutions which give our nation a competitive edge in the defence sector. We collaborate with our clients to bring ethical, reliable and cutting-edge AI to high-stakes situations and maintain the balance of global powers essential to our liberty.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Defence clients, you will need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work between 2 to 4 days per week on-site with these customers which may require travel to locations throughout the UK.

When not required on client sites, you’ll have the flexibility to work from our London office or remotely from elsewhere within the UK.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer in our Defence business unit, you will lead backend and edge/IoT engineering for critical work streams, implementing robust, scalable patterns. You’ll bridge the gap between machine learning research and production-grade software, raising the technical bar through hands-on contribution and peer mentoring.

Working alongside Lead Engineers and Data Scientists, you will scope and deliver high-impact solutions that provide immediate value to our customers in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

What You'll Be Doing

Designing and building robust backend and edge/IoT components for diverse client deliverables across multiple software domains.
Scoping and executing bounded technical problems to ensure high-velocity delivery.
Shipping production-ready code in Python and at least one compiled language such as Rust, C++, Go, C#, or Java.
Implementing scalable CI/CD processes, containerisation with Docker, and deployments on Kubernetes or bare metal.
Mentoring and pairing with fellow engineers to share best practices and empower the team to deliver their best work.
Collaborating with Machine Learning and Data Science teams to operationalise agentic software and advanced AI tooling.

Who We're Looking For

You possess strong hands-on experience in application development and a solid understanding of modern system architecture and design.
You have a proven track record of shipping code used by paying customers in both Python and a compiled language.
You are highly skilled in DevOps practices, including GitLab CI/CD, Docker, and managing applications in production environments.
You bring experience with agentic software development and a passion for understanding and solving complex customer problems.
You thrive when acting as a key contributor within a squad, taking ownership of technical challenges and elevating the team's output.
You communicate effectively with technical and commercial stakeholders, translating complex requirements into robust engineering solutions.

The Interview Process

Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)
System Design Interview (90 minutes)
Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)
Commercial & Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

This is a T-shaped role: you will bring deep technical expertise in at least one discipline that is of direct value to the team (AIS and REST APIs, SQL, Power Platform or Fabric), and combine it with the breadth and curiosity to act as a technical product owner across a defined portfolio of business-critical applications.

You will be comfortable talking to a range of people and translating technical ideas for non-technical audiences. Act as the primary liaison between internal users, procurement, support teams and vendors for your portfolio.
Manage vendor relationships, including coordinating support cases, overseeing service levels, and negotiating enhancements or customisations.
Monitor usage and performance, proactively addressing issues and identifying opportunities for improvement.
Maintain thorough documentation relating to change control, configuration, processes and procedures.

Cybersecurity and Risk

Proven experience of managing and supporting business-critical applications in a complex professional services, or similarly demanding, environment.

Experience with agile or iterative delivery methodologies and tools.

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer, London
jobs.description:
We're hiring a Customer Success Engineer to help customers turn our product into part of their everyday work. You'll combine practical customer success with building the systems, communications and learning experiences that make adoption repeatable.

About Us

Fifth Dimension builds AI software for the firms that invest in and manage real assets. We help people work with complex documents and business data, from leases and financial models to investment memos. We're a Series A company with offices in London, New York and Singapore.

Our values are Own It, Ship It and Don't Be Boring
. We move quickly, challenge each other kindly and care about making something customers actually use.

The Challenge

A useful product does not automatically become a useful daily habit. Customers need to connect their data, complete a valuable piece of work and come back to do it again. Your job is to make those steps easier, then make them work consistently across customers.

Imagine several customers are getting stuck connecting Microsoft 365. You help one through the setup, identify the shared problem, improve the guidance and follow-ups, and check whether more people reach their first useful result.

About You

You like helping people and making things. When the same question comes up twice, you start thinking about a better way to answer it. You can learn a technical product, explain it clearly and follow a problem through without waiting for a perfect brief.

You've probably spent one to three years in a technical customer role, implementation, support or operations. Strong projects, internships or your own business can demonstrate the same ability.

Your Impact

A practical individual contributor role, working directly with our CTO and closely with Customer Success, Account Management, Product and Engineering.
A builder who learns from individual customer problems and creates solutions that help many customers.
Ownership of onboarding, adoption programs and routine-support improvements, with experienced colleagues to learn from.

What This Role Is Not

A sales-quota or renewals role. Account Management owns commercial relationships.
A role spent solely answering tickets. You need time to build the systems that reduce repeat questions.
A senior software-engineering or bespoke enterprise-implementation role.

Day to Day, You Will

Build adoption programs: onboarding sequences, useful prompts and follow-ups based on what customers have actually done.
Improve first-line support: handle questions, find recurring issues, maintain useful guidance and build AI-assisted answers and routing, with tested output and clear human escalation.
Teach customers: run onboarding, webinars and office hours; make short videos, examples and guides people can use independently.
Make product releases useful: explain what changed, reach the people who will benefit and check whether they use it.
Troubleshoot: investigate configuration and integration issues, fix what you can and give engineers clear reproductions when the product needs to change.
Measure progress: track time to first value, repeat use and the manual work removed. Use the evidence to decide what to improve next.

What We're Looking For

Something useful you built yourself: an automation, small tool or integration you can explain and improve.
Practical AI use, with a habit of testing answers and checking what your tools produce.
Clear writing, patient teaching and confidence working directly with customers.
Comfort connecting tools and data through APIs, webhooks, scripting or automation platforms.
Reliable follow-through and enough data confidence to tell whether your work helped.

Nice To Have (But Not Required)

Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, product analytics, SQL or lifecycle communications.
Experience running training or supporting a specialist professional product.
Real estate or investment-management knowledge. You can learn the domain here.

Your First Few Months

Month 1. You can lead an onboarding session, have investigated real customer questions and have shipped your first useful automation or adoption improvement.
Month 3. A repeatable onboarding or feature-adoption program is running. You can show customers reaching value faster, using a valuable process more consistently, or the team doing less repetitive work.
Month 6. The programs you own reliably serve more customers without a matching rise in manual effort. You can explain which interventions improve sustained use and which you stopped. You and Chen will set targets from the starting baseline.

What We Offer You

Salary: £50,000–£70,000, plus equity. Hybrid, 2-3 days a week in the office.

Enhanced pension contributions and private healthcare through BUPA.
Generous paid time off and a two-week company shutdown in December.
Enhanced parental leave: 14 weeks for the primary caregiver and six for the secondary caregiver.
Direct access to experienced technical and customer colleagues, with meaningful ownership from the start.

jobs.title: AI Platform & Site Reliability Engineering Managing Consultant
jobs.description:
ABOUT CAPGEMINI

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

YOUR ROLE

As an AI Platform & Site Reliability Engineering Managing Consultant, you will help clients design, build and scale secure, reliable and operationally effective AI platforms. You will combine expertise in platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), observability and intelligent operations to help organisations move from isolated AI experimentation to production-grade, enterprise-scale AI services.

You will work with technology, engineering, operations and business leaders to establish the platforms, operating models, governance and reliability practices required to run AI-enabled services safely, effectively and at scale. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, you will shape client strategy while leading delivery teams and helping grow our AI Platform & Reliability Engineering capability.

This Will Include:

AI Platform Strategy & Architecture: Assess, define and evolve enterprise AI platform architectures, covering LLM and agentic frameworks, AI gateways, model lifecycle management, data platforms, MLOps/LLMOps foundations and integration patterns. Support clients in evaluating build, buy and hybrid approaches aligned to business needs, risk appetite and operational requirements.
AI Platform Engineering & LLMOps: Design and implement scalable AI platform capabilities including model deployment pipelines, prompt and model management, evaluation frameworks, AI observability, platform automation and operational guardrails. Enable reliable and repeatable delivery of AI services from experimentation through to production.
Reliability Engineering & SRE: Establish SRE practices including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, resilience engineering and reliability governance. Help clients shift from reactive operations to data-driven reliability management while balancing reliability, innovation and delivery velocity.
Observability & Operational Intelligence: Define observability strategies across applications, platforms and AI workloads using metrics, logs, traces and telemetry. Establish operational insight models that support proactive decision-making and enable advanced capabilities including anomaly detection, event intelligence, noise reduction and predictive operational analytics.
AI Operations & Service Reliability: Apply reliability engineering principles to AI-enabled services, monitoring AI-specific failure modes such as data quality degradation, hallucination patterns, token consumption, agent reliability and model performance drift. Implement controls, feedback loops and automated guardrails to ensure AI services remain secure, trusted and cost-effective.
Responsible AI & Platform Governance: Design and embed AI governance frameworks, model risk controls, compliance measures and responsible AI practices that address security, regulatory and ethical requirements while supporting innovation and adoption at scale.
Automation & Operational Efficiency: Identify opportunities to reduce operational complexity and toil through engineering-led automation, intelligent workflows and AI-enhanced operational practices. Help clients improve scalability, consistency and operational performance while reducing manual effort.
Client Advisory & Transformation Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor to CIO, CTO, CDO and Engineering leadership stakeholders, shaping platform strategies, operating models, vendor selections and transformation roadmaps. Lead consulting teams and workstreams from assessment and strategy through implementation and scale-up.

YOUR PROFILE

Essential Experience

Proven experience designing, delivering and operating cloud-native, platform engineering, AI platform or reliability engineering solutions within complex enterprise environments.
Strong understanding of AI platform architectures including LLMOps, MLOps, agentic AI frameworks, model lifecycle management and AI operational controls.
Experience establishing and scaling SRE practices including observability, SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident management and reliability engineering.
Strong understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, regulatory requirements and model risk management.
Experience implementing observability strategies using modern monitoring, telemetry and operational analytics platforms.
Demonstrated ability to advise senior stakeholders and lead multidisciplinary transformation programmes.
Experience working across hyperscaler ecosystems including Azure, AWS and Google Cloud Platform.
Proven ability to balance business outcomes, user needs, engineering constraints and operational requirements when shaping platform strategies.

Desirable Experience

Experience with AI observability, model monitoring, AI governance tooling or AI platform operations.
Experience of platform engineering, DevSecOps, automation and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
Experience developing propositions, leading bids and supporting business growth activities.
Active participation in AI, SRE, platform engineering or cloud communities.

Certifications (Desirable)

Azure AI Engineer Associate
Azure Solutions Architect Expert
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Cloud Architect
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
SRE Foundation or SRE Practitioner
Relevant observability platform certifications (Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk etc.)

Security Check (SC) Clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. (https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant#levels-of-national-security-clearance)

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE

Client engagements give you the opportunity to work with our leadership and experienced consulting management, where you can learn from them, challenge them, and accelerate your hands-on experience, delivery capability and industry insights.
You’ll learn how we write compelling client propositions, structure, and lead high-profile transformation, and gain hands-on exposure to leading technologies, often taking an idea from a concept to a vision, to strategy and then execution.
Our consultants are formally trained from industry experts on management consulting and client delivery.
We provide a host of opportunities for learning and certification through internal and partner led programmes from AWS, Google and Microsoft.
Les Fontaines: Capgemini Invent has a unique training environment just outside of Paris, where we can immerse ourselves in thought-leadership, share knowledge and build capabilities which will help us and our clients to succeed.
We hold monthly showcases of our initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients.
There are many opportunities like monthly team drinks to connect face-to-face with the wider team over a few drinks in the city. There are regular leadership connect sessions that will give you a different, more relaxed setting to meet up in the office to hear from the leadership, meet colleagues and discuss the trends and insights within the market. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new.

As Part Of Your Role You Will Also Have The Opportunity To Contribute To The Business And Your Own Personal Growth, Through Activities That Form Part Of The Following Categories:

Business Development
– Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.

Internal Contribution
– Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.

Learning & Developmen
t – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2023 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

WE'RE A DISABILITY CONFIDENT EMPLOYER

Capgemini Is Proud To Be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) Under The UK Government’s Disability Confident Scheme. As Part Of Our Commitment To Inclusive Recruitment, We Will Offer An Interview To All Candidates Who:

Declare they have a disability, and
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Head of Engineering – Energy Trading | £150,000 + Bonus + Benefits | Paddington, London – 4 Days Office

A leading organisation within the energy trading sector
is undergoing a major technology transformation, modernising its core trading, data, and analytics platforms. With significant investment into its technology function, the business is building a next-generation platform to support data-driven decision making and improve the way its trading teams operate.

As part of this transformation, the organisation is seeking a Head of Engineering
to lead a growing technology function across software development, data engineering and QA
. This is a senior engineering leadership position with responsibility for technical direction, engineering standards, delivery and team development.

The Opportunity

This is a key leadership role for an experienced engineering leader who enjoys working in a hands-on, technically complex environment. You will lead the engineering function while remaining close to the technology, working with developers, data engineers and QA engineers to deliver high-quality platforms supporting the firm's energy trading activities.
You will take ownership of engineering strategy and delivery, helping shape the architecture, development practices and technology roadmap. You will work closely with senior stakeholders across technology and the business to ensure the engineering function continues to support the firm's trading and commercial objectives.

The platform will process and integrate large volumes of data, supporting teams across energy trading, risk, analytics and operations
. You will have the opportunity to shape a modern engineering function and play a key role in the ongoing transformation of the firm's technology estate.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and develop the engineering function across Software Development, Data Engineering and QA
.
• Own the engineering strategy, technical direction and delivery of critical technology across the firm's energy trading platform.
• Build and maintain a high-performing engineering team, supporting recruitment, development, mentoring and progression.
• Provide technical leadership across architecture, software development, data platforms, testing and system integration.
• Work closely with senior technology and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
• Oversee the development of applications, APIs, microservices and data platforms supporting energy trading.
• Establish and maintain strong engineering standards around code quality, testing, deployment and documentation.
• Drive the adoption of modern development practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, cloud technologies and DevOps.
• Ensure close collaboration between developers, data engineers and QA throughout the development lifecycle.
• Help shape the long-term architecture and technology roadmap as the organisation continues its modernisation programme.
• Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, creating a strong culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience leading an engineering function or large engineering team within a complex technology environment.
• Strong background in software engineering, ideally with experience across development, data engineering and QA
.
• Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, microservices and data platforms.
• Experience with C#/.NET would be highly advantageous.
• Strong understanding of cloud technologies, DevOps, CI/CD and automated testing.
• Experience building and developing high-performing engineering teams.
• Comfortable operating at both a strategic and technical level, with the ability to engage with engineers as well as senior business stakeholders.
• Experience working with complex data environments or high-volume, real-time systems.
• Energy trading, commodities or financial markets experience would be highly advantageous.
• A strong communicator who can provide clear technical direction while giving engineering teams the autonomy to deliver.

Compensation
: Up to £150,000 + Bonus + Benefits
Location
: Paddington, London
Working Pattern
: 4 days per week in the office
If you’re an experienced engineering leader looking to take ownership of a growing technology function at the heart of an energy trading business, send your CV to Joe@virtuetech.io or reply

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

What You Will Do

At Volvo Group Digital & IT, you will contribute to the transformation of our company, the transport industry, and society at large. In this role, you will:

Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications using C#, .NET, Angular, and Microsoft SQL Server
Build, test, debug, and optimize software solutions to ensure performance, scalability, security, and maintainability
Design and implement REST APIs and high-quality front-end components that support strong user experience
Optimize SQL Server databases through efficient query design, indexing strategies, and performance improvements
Collaborate with product managers, designers, architects, and developers to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions
Provide senior technical guidance, promote engineering best practices, and actively contribute to Agile delivery across the full software lifecycle

Your future team

You will join a collaborative and experienced team of developers dedicated to development of North American Master Data applications. We take ownership of the full lifecycle, from design through development, testing, delivery, and continuous improvement.

Who are you?

Must have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
5 to 7 years of proven experience in software development with strong specialization in .NET technologies
Deep expertise in .NET, C#, Entity Framework, ASP.NET, MVC, Web API, REST APIs, and Test-Driven Development
Strong hands-on experience with Angular and extensive experience with Microsoft SQL Server, including database design and optimization
Strong understanding of software design patterns, scalable system design, and best practices for maintainable software
Exceptional problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly

Nice to have

Familiarity with Agile methodologies, especially Scrum
Proven track record of leading technical projects from inception to deployment
Ability to communicate effectively across a global development team

What’s in it for you?

We offer a solid compensation and benefits package. In addition, you will enjoy:

Work in an international, cross-functional team rooted in Swedish collaborative culture
Modern technology stack and high engineering standards
Learning and development opportunities, including access to Azure Academy, Pluralsight, and internal Volvo resources
Be part of a fun-loving team dedicated to delivering high-quality applications

Ready for the next move?

Are you excited to bring your skills and innovative ideas to the table? We cannot wait to hear from you. Apply today.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

Who We Are And What We Believe In

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

Volvo Group Digital Technology & Operations (DTO)

At Endava, we harness technology to drive meaningful change. By combining AI-native engineering, deep industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we partner with leading organisations to solve complex business challenges and create digital products and platforms that make a lasting impact.

From strategy and design to engineering and operations, we help our customers accelerate innovation and transform their businesses. Join us and be part of a global team delivering work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers. You will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of significant work packages and make sound technical decisions within the agreed platform direction.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Help deliver secure, reusable authentication and authorization services used by multiple product teams.
Build high-quality .NET APIs, Angular administration tools and integration services that are maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve the reliability, scalability and security of shared identity services through well-tested engineering changes.
Support platform adoption by improving SDKs, documentation, developer tooling and integration patterns.
Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Key Responsibilities

Identity Platform Development

Design, develop and maintain authentication and authorization services using modern .NET technologies.
Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Platform Services & Developer Experience

Develop reusable SDKs, libraries and APIs that simplify integration with the enterprise identity platform.
Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.
Improve developer experience by simplifying authentication, authorization and platform integration.
Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting engineering teams consuming the platform.
Help minimise breaking changes by designing stable, reusable platform interfaces.
Take ownership of technical designs and implementation approaches for assigned capabilities, identifying dependencies, risks and trade-offs and following work through to a production-ready outcome.
Lead focused technical work packages and provide practical guidance to other engineers contributing to the same capability.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Develop cloud-native services running on Microsoft Azure.
Build and maintain reverse proxy capabilities using Azure API Management.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.
Support continuous improvements in platform scalability, security and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring platform quality and reliability.
Participate in peer reviews, architecture discussions and technical design sessions.
Promote engineering best practices including Clean Code, automated testing and secure software development.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers and Platform Engineers to deliver high-quality platform capabilities.
Support less experienced engineers through constructive reviews, knowledge sharing and technical mentoring.

Operations & Collaboration

Participate in third-line production support and on-call rotation.
Investigate production issues and contribute to platform reliability improvements.
Work closely with multiple product teams integrating with the platform.
Share knowledge and contribute to establishing long-term Endava ownership of the Authentication & Authorization capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

6+ years of commercial software development experience using C# and modern .NET.
Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.
Experience building scalable enterprise applications or shared platform services.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and modern software design principles.

Identity & Security

Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and JWT.
Good understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts.
Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity providers.
Understanding of secure API design and identity-based access control.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or OpenTofu.
Understanding of Azure API Management or similar API Gateway technologies.

Front-End Development

Experience developing Angular applications using TypeScript.
Experience building administrative or developer-facing web applications.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration and API testing).
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple product teams.
Ability to influence technical outcomes across team boundaries, communicate delivery risks and contribute to decisions affecting shared platform consumers.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer with OAuth
jobs.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why.

At Endava, we harness technology to drive meaningful change. By combining AI-native engineering, deep industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we partner with leading organisations to solve complex business challenges and create digital products and platforms that make a lasting impact.

From strategy and design to engineering and operations, we help our customers accelerate innovation and transform their businesses. Join us and be part of a global team delivering work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Help deliver secure, reusable authentication and authorization services used by multiple product teams.
Build high-quality .NET APIs, Angular administration tools and integration services that are maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve the reliability, scalability and security of shared identity services through well-tested engineering changes.
Support platform adoption by improving SDKs, documentation, developer tooling and integration patterns.
Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Key Responsibilities

Identity Platform Development

Design, develop and maintain authentication and authorization services using modern .NET technologies.
Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Platform Services & Developer Experience

Develop reusable SDKs, libraries and APIs that simplify integration with the enterprise identity platform.
Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.
Improve developer experience by simplifying authentication, authorization and platform integration.
Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting engineering teams consuming the platform.
Help minimise breaking changes by designing stable, reusable platform interfaces.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Develop cloud-native services running on Microsoft Azure.
Build and maintain reverse proxy capabilities using Azure API Management.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.
Support continuous improvements in platform scalability, security and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring platform quality and reliability.
Participate in peer reviews, architecture discussions and technical design sessions.
Promote engineering best practices including Clean Code, automated testing and secure software development.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers and Platform Engineers to deliver high-quality platform capabilities.

Operations & Collaboration

Participate in third-line production support and on-call rotation.
Investigate production issues and contribute to platform reliability improvements.
Work closely with multiple product teams integrating with the platform.
Share knowledge and contribute to establishing long-term Endava ownership of the Authentication & Authorization capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

4+ years of commercial software development experience using C# and modern .NET.
Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.
Experience building scalable enterprise applications or shared platform services.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and modern software design principles.

Identity & Security

Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and JWT.
Good understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts.
Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity providers.
Understanding of secure API design and identity-based access control.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Understanding of Infrastructure as Code principles, with the ability and willingness to work with tools such as OpenTofu or Terraform.
Understanding of Azure API Management or similar API Gateway technologies.

Front-End Development

Experience developing Angular applications using TypeScript.
Experience building administrative or developer-facing web applications.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration and API testing).
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple product teams.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Auth0
Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA)
Google Zanzibar authorization model
Azure API Management (APIM)
SCIM integrations
Identity Federation
Datadog
Playwright
Trivy
GitLeaks
Invicti
Experience building reusable developer platforms
Experience working with enterprise shared services

Additional Information

For this position, the gross base salary starts from PLN 15 267 PLN Gross per month (full-time employment contract), determined using objective and gender-neutral criteria including skillset, experience and role responsibilities.

Our benefits offering typically include private medical insurance, dental plan, and glasses reimbursement. The figure represents the initial remuneration we expect to offer for this role and does not limit the right to equal pay for women and men performing the same work or work of equal value. All remuneration and benefits decisions are based on non-discriminatory, gender-neutral criteria, and in accordance with the Polish Labour Code amendments implementing Directive on pay transparency, we do not request or consider candidates’ current or past remuneration during the recruitment process.”

jobs.description:
🔵 Project Description:

Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC -Luxoft.

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
AI Labs is a sub-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self-serve access to the AI-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.

Your Skills And Experiences

- BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
- Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
- Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C#, PowerShell, Python
- Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
- Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
- Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
- Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
- Proactive thinking, excellent problem-solving, and analytical skills
- Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
- Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
- Fluent in English

Preferred Skills

- Strong coding skills (e.g. C#, PowerShell)
- Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
- Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
- Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
- Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.

🔵 Responsibilities:

- Support the integration between Collibra and Microsoft Fabric, including evaluating Fabric's capabilities for data provision.
- Manage Fabric-native catalog and discovery functionalities.
- Oversee metadata management and business glossary maintenance.
- Facilitate data product discovery and data shopping processes.
- Handle governance, access management, and data protection policies.
- Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and validate Fabric architecture.
- Design components such as OneLake, data mesh, and semantic layers.
- Develop cloud architectural strategies ensuring security, scalability, and compliance.
- Serve as a trusted advisor to align technical solutions with strategic objectives and advocate customer interests among diverse stakeholders.
- Design and implement governance automation leveraging modern technologies and cloud best practices.
- Lead technical collaboration with business, development, and infrastructure teams.
- Produce technical documentation, architecture decision records, and implement DevOps practices including infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployments.
- Coordinate team resources, resolve technical issues, and work within Agile frameworks, including Scrum and Kanban, for defining, estimating, and delivering work.

Python,
Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS),
Microsoft Azure DevOps,
Microsoft Azure Services,
Microsoft Data Fabric,
Network,
IP Routing,
TCP/IP,

experience in building AI Landing zones,
experience with FabricIO & o365 agents,

Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies

Background testing PAM, IAM, or other security/compliance products

Familiarity with VM-based or emulated system testing (Windows/Linux)

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Nasz Klient to zespół specjalistów, pełnych pasji miłośników technologicznych usprawnień, którzy swoimi
projektami ułatwiają pracę firm z branż energetycznej, telekomunikacyjnej i rynku nieruchomości komercyjnych.
Firma powstała jako spółka córka większej grupy kapitałowej działającej na rynku telekomunikacyjnym od ponad
20 lat i rozwija aplikacje przede wszystkim dla jej klientów. Firma jest w fazie rozwoju, stąd potrzeba rozbudowy zespołu o kolejnych specjalistów i nowe kompetencje.

Poszukujemy Konsultanta do objęcia roli: QUALITY ASSURANCE ENGINEER (CONTRACTOR)

Miejsce pracy: Warszawa (Al. Armii Ludowej, koło stacji metra)
Praca hybrydowa (4 dni stacjonarnie + 1 zdalnie)
Kontrakt B2B na czas określony, z opcją przedłużenia w mniejszym wymiarze godzin

Twoja misja: zbudujesz proces QA od podstaw

Obecnie testowaniem zajmują się programiści, nie ma niezależnego procesu QA. Szukamy osoby, która oceni
sytuację i zaprojektuje proces testowania od zera i realnie wpłynie na jakość systemów używanych przez
kilkanaście spółek energetycznych i telekomunikacyjnych (łącznie ok. 150 użytkowników biznesowych).
Zależy nam na kimś, kto już budował taki proces w innych organizacjach.
Po wdrożeniu podstawowego procesu przewidziana jest kontynuacja współpracy w mniejszym wymiarze godzin,
do utrzymania i rozwijania tego, co zostanie zbudowane w pierwszym etapie.

Dlaczego to ma znaczenie:
● masz realny wpływ na to, jak ta rola będzie wyglądać, zbudujesz od podstaw proces testowania
● zbudujesz niezależną warstwę kontroli jakości dla integracji o wysokiej cenie błędu (KSeF, CSIRE, biling).
● twoja praca realnie zmniejszy ryzyko kosztownych poprawek po wdrożeniu

Brzmi jak rola dla Ciebie? Przejdźmy do konkretów.

Nad jakimi projektami pracuje zespół?

Aplikacje biznesowe (CRM, billing) dla klientów z grupy kapitałowej - spółki telekomunikacyjne i energetyczne - oraz integracje z systemami zewnętrznymi: KSeF (Krajowy System e-Faktur) i CSIRE (Centralny System Informacji Rynku Energii). Stack technologiczny aplikacji: C#, WinForms, .NET 8. Narzędzia do testowania będą ustalone wspólnie z Tobą.

Czym będziesz się zajmować?
● zaprojektujesz i wdrożysz proces QA od podstaw: plany testów, przypadki testowe, regresję dla
kluczowych modułów CRM/bilingowych oraz integracji KSeF/CSIRE,
● koordynowaniem UAT z klientem końcowym,
● budową pierwszych automatyzacji testów (dobór narzędzi do ustalenia; np. xUnit/NUnit do testów jednostkowych, ewentualnie Playwright/Selenium przy migracji na web),
● tworzeniem dokumentacji testowej,
● ścisłą współpracą z CTO i 5-osobowym zespołem deweloperskim przy analizie zgłoszonych błędów i
priorytetyzacji ryzyka.

Oczekiwania
● doświadczenie w testowaniu aplikacji biznesowych,
● doświadczenie w budowaniu procesu testowania od podstaw
● umiejętność samodzielnego projektowania planów testów i przypadków testowych
● doświadczenie w testowaniu integracji API/systemów zewnętrznych
● mile widziane podstawy automatyzacji testów
● mile widziane doświadczenie w koordynacji UAT z klientem końcowym
● znajomość JIRA i/lub Azure DevOps Test Plans
● podstawowa znajomość SQL (do weryfikacji danych po testach)
● mile widziana znajomość branży energetycznej i telekomunikacyjnej, a przede wszystkim otwartość i gotowość do wdrożenia się w regulacje dotyczące tych obszarów,
● umiejętność pracy z wieloma interesariuszami jednocześnie,
● proaktywność, nastawienie na szukanie rozwiązań,
● skrupulatność, rzetelność i odpowiedzialność za powierzone zadania.

Dlaczego warto?
● forma współpracy - kontrakt B2B na czas określony, z opcją przedłużenia w mniejszym wymiarze
godzin,
● benefity: karta Multisport i opieka Medicover,
● ciekawe merytorycznie środowisko regulacyjne - pracujesz przy tematach związanych z KSeF i
CSIRE, czyli realnych, zmieniających się wymogach prawnych dla energetyki i telekomunikacji,
● mały, kameralny zespół: 5 osób w zespole developerskim, bezpośredni kontakt z CTO, decyzje
podejmowane bez kilkunastu warstw akceptacji i bez czekania tygodniami
● praca z konkretem: nie pracujesz w fabryce kodu, ale w miejscu tworzenia rozwiązań dla konkretnych
