jobs.title: Engineering Manager — Change Systems
jobs.description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About The Organization

Platform Modernization Engineering (PME) helps keep Netflix's engineering fleet healthy, secure, and current. We design and run the large-scale migration and modernization campaigns that move the fleet forward — from dependency upgrades to infrastructure-level changes — so that individual engineering teams don't have to absorb that toil on their own.

About The Team And The Role

The Change Systems team owns the platforms that make fleet-wide change possible at Netflix. It gives engineering teams across the company a unified way to scope, launch, automate, and validate change at scale — from routine dependency updates to complex, multi-service migrations — with as little manual toil as possible.

The platform already operates at significant scale: over 100 engineering teams run change activities across thousands of repositories, and usage continues to grow year over year. The team's mandate is expanding to match — pushing automation further using AI-assisted code modification, rule-based transformations, and batch orchestration. The goal is to make the majority of change at Netflix low-to-no-effort for the engineers on the receiving end, while giving the teams driving that change the tooling, telemetry, and adoption data they need to move with confidence.

You will lead the engineers who build and operate this platform, based in Warsaw. This is a team with deep end-to-end ownership: they run their own on-call, design the automation and orchestration layers directly, and are pushing the platform toward AI-driven code transformation as a first-class capability rather than a one-off tool.

End-to-end Ownership Translates Into Several Responsibilities

from a technical perspective, acting like a System Architect, driving technical architecture and component integration;
from a product perspective, wearing the Product Manager hat for Campaigns and defining the vision and strategy for the Campaigns experience;
from a partnership and stakeholders' perspective, identifying needs, incorporating feedback, aligning across the organization, creating partnerships to drive impact
from a leadership perspective, acting like a Change Agent and Advocate supporting the overall organization in shaping the mindset and approach around Campaigns (change at scale) in the agentic world;

The platform is at an inflection point, which makes this role particularly important:

From tooling to platform. Change Systems has built strong point solutions for individual campaigns. The next step is composable, declarative abstractions that every part of the platform — and the teams building on top of it — share a common foundation rather than one-off automation.
From manual campaign design to AI-assisted execution. GenAI-driven code transformation, contract-based validation, and batch orchestration are becoming core to how campaigns get executed — across code transformation, CI, testing, and delivery to production.
From reactive to metrics-driven prioritization. Using historical campaign completion data to predict bottlenecks, target specific automation investments, and measure adoption and adherence rather than simply responding to inbound requests.
From isolated campaigns to a coherent customer experience. Close technical alignment is required with Source Management, Continuous Integration, Resilience Engineering and Delivery Engineering and Security so that campaign recipients experience one coherent platform, not a patchwork of tools.

What You Will Do

Be a thought partner to Organization Champions, Campaign Managers, Campaign Recipients, and engineering leadership in setting the vision, strategy, and adoption path for fleet-wide change management as a platform capability.
Own the technical architecture direction for a composable, declarative platform that generalizes beyond any single migration use case.
Serve as a credible technical advisor to your team, helping engineers navigate ambiguous, cross-domain technical decisions — and act as the team's escalation point for novel campaigns that span multiple technical domains.
Drive AI-first ways of working across the team: treat AI-assisted code modification as core infrastructure, and advance agent-assisted engineering practices with the code review, change-risk management, testing, and evaluation rigor required to run them safely at scale.
Raise the team's rigor around impact — define meaningful adoption and adherence metrics, use historical campaign data to predict and target automation investment, and prioritize based on evidence rather than only inbound requests.
Own the operational excellence of a platform relied on across the fleet, including on-call responsibilities, telemetry and dashboards for fleet health, and feedback loops that continuously improve campaign design and execution.
Communicate complex technical and product tradeoffs clearly, in writing and verbally, to influence decisions across a broad set of stakeholders — including technical executives, SREs, and security incident commanders.
Lead, hire, coach, and develop a team of engineers; challenge them to expand their ownership and grow their impact beyond their immediate scope.
Foster a strong culture of accountability, and build an inclusive team environment where every engineer feels empowered to contribute at their best.

What We Are Looking For

Experience building and operating platform systems that support large-scale, business-critical use cases, including on-call responsibilities and resilient, well-instrumented services.
Strong technical acumen in distributed systems and developer platforms, with the ability to move between architecture and implementation detail, and to represent technical decisions credibly to partner teams.
Experience building and leading inclusive engineering teams, attracting and retaining talent, and fostering a culture where individuals take ownership while contributing to shared outcomes.
Strong long-term strategic thinking and a platform mindset — able to define a technical vision for composable, extensible systems and connect it to broader organizational goals.
Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and partner effectively with senior stakeholders across engineering, product, and security.
Rigor in decision-making: comfortable reducing ambiguity through a mix of data, stakeholder input, constructive dissent, and targeted experiments.
Fluency with AI-assisted engineering, with a clear point of view on how to adopt GenAI-driven code transformation and agentic tooling safely at scale.
Strong technical writing skills — design docs, tradeoff analyses, postmortems — and a track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical projects from design through completion.

Nice to Have

Experience with large-scale code migration or modernization campaigns.
Experience building or operating fleet-management, dependency graph, or service catalog systems.
Background in platform or infrastructure engineering organizations.
Familiarity with Java or Python in a backend services context.
Experience designing platforms where agents, not just humans, are first-class consumers — including provisioning and debugging through APIs rather than a UI.
Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred: EC2, S3, EKS/Kubernetes).

jobs.title: Agentic Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Agentic Solution Architect

Who are we?

We are an AI-native consulting and product development company that helps businesses transform ambitious ideas into production-ready AI solutions. Working with small, highly experienced teams, we combine strategic consulting with hands-on engineering to deliver real business outcomes. Rather than separating strategy from execution, we take ownership from concept to production, partnering closely with clients every step of the way.
What do we do?

We help organizations identify where AI can create meaningful business value, validate ideas quickly, and scale successful solutions across the enterprise. Our projects include AI-first enterprise products, intelligent automation platforms, cloud-native systems, and complex digital transformation initiatives. Every solution is designed with scalability, reliability, and long-term business impact in mind.
Why do we do it?

We believe AI should solve real problems, not simply showcase the latest technology. Our goal is to help companies adopt AI in a practical, sustainable way by building solutions that improve business performance, empower teams, and deliver measurable results. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, and delivering software that people actually use.
How do we do it?

We work side by side with our clients to understand their business, design the right technical solutions, and actively participate in implementation. Our architects don't stop at diagrams, they prototype ideas, write code, validate assumptions, support engineering teams, and ensure that every architectural decision balances scalability, cost, delivery speed, and business value.
Who works with us?

You'll join a team of senior engineers, solution architects, and AI specialists who enjoy solving challenging technical problems and building modern software. Our teams are intentionally lean, giving every engineer the opportunity to influence technical direction, collaborate directly with clients, and make meaningful architectural decisions.
Why is there a vacancy?

As demand for AI-powered enterprise solutions continues to grow, we're expanding our architecture team to support new client engagements and increasingly complex projects. We're looking for an experienced architect who enjoys taking ownership of technical decisions and staying involved throughout the entire product lifecycle: from discovery and design to implementation and continuous improvement.
Who are we looking for?

We're looking for a hands-on Solution Architect with a strong software engineering background who enjoys turning complex business challenges into practical technical solutions. You should be comfortable working directly with clients, making architecture decisions, mentoring engineering teams, and contributing code whenever necessary.
What professional skills are important to us?

Required

8+ years of software engineering experience
3+ years in software or solution architecture
Strong experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
Solid understanding of cloud-native architectures, containers, serverless technologies, and Infrastructure as Code
Experience integrating AI/ML models into production systems
Knowledge of enterprise architecture, security, compliance, and legacy system integration
Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Hands-on coding experience in modern production environments

Nice to have

Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, finance, or government
Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or custom LLM deployment experience
Cloud cost optimization and Total Cost of Ownership analysis
Experience with edge computing, IoT, or distributed systems

What will you do?

As an Agentic Solution Architect, you will:

Analyze existing business processes, systems, and technical landscapes
Design scalable architectures, APIs, integrations, and cloud infrastructure
Build prototypes to validate architectural decisions before implementation
Contribute production code when needed
Support engineering teams throughout development
Review code and provide technical guidance
Work directly with clients to understand business needs and define technical strategies
Establish performance, scalability, reliability, and recovery objectives
Assess security, compliance, and operational risks
Document architectural decisions and continuously improve deployed solutions

What do we offer?

Competitive salary with performance-based bonus
Equity opportunities where applicable
Fully remote work within GMT-1 to GMT+4
Up to 22 days of paid time off plus public holidays
Premium laptop and modern equipment
Personal learning and development budget
Access to cutting-edge AI tools and technologies
Opportunity to work on high-impact AI products for international clients
A collaborative environment with experienced engineers and architects who value ownership, innovation, and continuous learning

Our hiring process

Our interview process is designed to evaluate practical problem-solving and architectural thinking:

Introduction Call (30 minutes) –
Learn more about each other and discuss your experience.
Technical Interview (45 minutes) –
Explore your technical background, engineering approach, and architectural experience.
System Design Session (60–90 minutes) –
Solve a real-world architecture challenge together.
Final Decision & Offer

We focus on practical engineering, thoughtful decision-making, and real-world experience, not trick questions or theoretical exercises.

jobs.description:
About Us

ERGO Technology & Services S.A. (ET&S), a member of the Munich Re and ERGO Group, is delivering integrated IT and business services to international markets. Our expertise lies in providing advanced IT services, with a focus on modern, business-driven technology solutions. On the business side, we also support the Group in various end-to-end insurance processes, including finance, operations, and underwriting. With offices in Warsaw and Gdansk, and strong global partnerships, we foster a dynamic, multicultural environment that promotes diversity and international opportunities.

About the role

As a part of the Reinsurance Life and Health Tower you are responsible for RI Life and Health Solution Delivery. We drive the transformation of project delivery and product management for RI Life and Health business units across North and South America, Europe, and Asia.
In the data and digital section, we are responsible for data-driven, automation, and digital initiatives in the Reinsurance Life and Health businesses. By leveraging innovative technologies such as data analytics and AI, we develop and support solutions for both client-facing and internal operations.
As an Architect for Advanced Analytics, embedded in a team of cross functional solution architects, you will lead the data definitions as well as support the design and engineering of highly appropriate, tightly integrated, flexible and fault-tolerant data repositories and systems with the lens of a consistent end to end data architecture and high data quality. You will moreover support data governance in the design of the required governance, management, and operational processes around data quality for the overall data strategy implementation of an integrated and regulatory compliant data ecosystem.

How you will get the job done

designing, developing, and implementing scalable, secure cloud-based architectures for data solutions, ensuring high availability and performance (e.g., Azure, Databricks, Kubernetes)
designing modular platform architectures that integrate both current and emerging technologies
designing platform architectures with deliberate modularity and abstraction boundaries that accommodate the integration of technologies not yet available or only existing as research prototypes
defining enterprise data models and end-to-end data architecture — from ingestion through transformation to consumption, ensuring consistency, lineage traceability, and fitness for analytics and AI workloads
supporting the design and operationalization of data governance processes including data quality frameworks, data cataloging, ownership models, and stewardship workflows, aligned with the overall data strategy
implementing continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for efficient and automated model deployment and updates
maintaining comprehensive architecture documentation, including design patterns, best practices, and cloud service configurations
ensuring platform architecture complies with industry standards and regulations and integrates best practices for data privacy and security
continuously evaluating emerging technologies (including new AI/ML products, novel data processing paradigms, and next-generation cloud services) for their potential to enhance the analytics platform, and translating evaluations into actionable architectural recommendations
working closely with development teams, business stakeholders, and other architects to ensure seamless integration of data, AI, and cloud services into the overall application landscape

Skills and experience you will need

fluency in English
University degree in Computer Science or a related field
several years of experience in IT architecture with focus on data solutions and AI technologies
proven experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and familiarity with services like data lakes, cloud storage, containerization, and orchestration (Kubernetes)
demonstrated track record of evaluating and integrating emerging technologies at early maturity stages
strong experience in data architecture and data modeling across the full data lifecycle; familiarity with architecture frameworks (e.g., C4, arc42) and data lineage tooling
experience with data governance practices, data quality management, and familiarity with data cataloging and metadata management tools
deep understanding of cloud security principles, encryption, access control, and regulatory compliance requirements
solid understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices
proficiency in Python/R, with experience in AI/ML libraries (e.g., Hugging Face, OpenAI, Langchain) and PowerBI
familiarity with core LLM techniques like Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI databases, etc.
active engagement with the evolving AI/ML landscape, including awareness of developments beyond current production frameworks (e.g., agentic systems, advanced reasoning architectures, next-generation data processing paradigms)
excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
adaptive mindset: proven ability to rapidly assimilate new technology paradigms, pivot architectural approaches when the landscape shifts, and make sound design decisions under technological uncertainty

Nice to have

German language skills are a strong advantage, but not required
experience with serverless architectures is a plus

What we offer

– medical package coverage, co-financing a sports card, and numerous sports sections – these are some of the benefits that help our employees to stay in good shape.
Let’s be balanced
– we offer our employees flexible working hours and the possibility of remote working. However, staying at home with our in-office gaming room and dog-friendly office in Warsaw won’t be easy.

– we organize numerous workshops and training courses. Thanks to hackathons and meetups, our specialists share their expertise with others. Additionally, we have a wide range of digital learning platforms and language courses.
Let’s be responsible
– each year, we participate in several CSR activities, during which, together with our colleagues, we do our best to create a better future.
Let’s be fun
– company-wide bike races and soccer matches, film marathons in our cinema room or other engaging team-building activities – we got it covered!
Let’s be diverse
– every team member is valued, regardless of gender, nationality, religious beliefs, disability, age, and sexual orientation or identity. Your qualifications, experience, and mindset are our greatest benefit!

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ALTEN in Sweden is looking for a Software Engineer (.NET Core/C#) to join our team in Gothenburg for an on-site opportunity with a leading client in the Automotive sector. You will play a key role in developing and maintaining the communication interface between vehicles and tools, including remote operations, ensuring seamless integration throughout the product lifecycle, from development and testing to manufacturing and remote scenarios.

What do we offer?
A challenging and varied role in an innovative and international environment
The opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and industry-leading clients
A collaborative and supportive team culture where your contributions make a real impact
Career development and growth opportunities within ALTEN

About the role
As a Software Engineer, you will be part of a skilled and engaged Scrum team, working according to agile principles to design, implement, and test solutions for vehicle-to-tool communication interfaces. You will collaborate directly with stakeholders to develop common and reusable solutions that drive customer success. Your work will span the entire product lifecycle, ensuring robustness, scalability, and efficiency in a dynamic environment.

Your expertise in C# and .NET Core will be critical, but your ability to deliver end-to-end solutions, from design to support and acceptance testing, is what will truly set you apart. Experience with communication protocols (design/implementation) is a plus, as is your adaptability in a self-organizing team where everyone contributes across all aspects of the product.

Your main responsibilities
Develop and maintain communication interfaces between vehicles and tools, including remote operations
Design, implement, and test software solutions for the entire product lifecycle
Collaborate with stakeholders to create reusable and scalable solutions
Work in an agile Scrum team, contributing to all aspects of the product (design, implementation, testing)
Ensure customer success through direct communication and problem-solving

Your profile
You are a team player with a passion for delivering high-quality solutions and supporting your colleagues to achieve shared goals.
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
6+ years of hands-on programming experience in C# and .NET Core
Expert-level proficiency in C# and deep knowledge of .NET Framework and runtime internals
Proven experience with AOT compilation strategies (e.g., for embedded Linux)
Experience with cross-platform development (Android, iOS) using .NET MAUI or Xamarin
Strong backend engineering experience in containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
Familiarity with Lua scripting and dynamic script generation pipelines (merit)
Understanding of automotive diagnostic protocols (UDS ISO 14229, ISO 15765-2, SAE J1575, RP1210 A-D) (merit)
Experience working with OEMs or heavy-duty automotive diagnostics (merit)
Fluent in English (written and spoken)

ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in nearly 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the value chain of the most prestigious companies in all sectors, such as Automotive, Defense, Energy & Environment, Industry, Public services & Government and Life Sciences. In Sweden, we are about 1300 committed employees with 9 offices in 9 cities - from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.

For the sixth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden's most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, an award for employers that offer unique career and development opportunities.

jobs.title: Backend & DevOps-konsult (direktuppdrag) - Kollarna.se
jobs.description:
På Doktor.se definierar vi om det svenska sjukvårdssystemet genom att göra det mer tillgängligt, smidigt och effektivt, utan att kompromissa med kvalitet eller säkerhet. Vår hybridmodell, som kombinerar fysiska vårdcentraler med moderna digitala lösningar, har gjort oss till den största digitala vårdgivaren i Sverige, med miljontals konsultationer varje år.

Om uppdraget

Vi söker en erfaren Backend- och DevOps-konsult för ett uppdrag hos Kollarna.se, en tjänst som erbjuds av Doktor.se:s dotterbolag Doktor24.se. Vi vill arbeta direkt med dig som konsult, utan mellanhänder.

Uppdraget syftar till att stärka och modernisera Kollarnas infrastruktur i Azure, med fokus på säkerhet, skalbarhet och automatisering. Du arbetar i nära samarbete med Kollarnas utvecklingsteam och driver dina leveranser självständigt mot överenskomna mål.

Vad uppdraget innebär

Uppdraget omfattar följande leveranser:

Genomlysning av nuvarande Azure-miljö och säkerhetsläge, med prioriterade åtgärdsförslag.
Införande av infrastructure as code för befintliga tjänster.
Översyn och förenkling av CI/CD-pipelines i GitHub Actions.
Uppsättning av monitorering och larm, samt översyn av skalbarhet, t.ex. databaser och cachning (Redis).
Rådgivning i design- och arkitekturfrågor som rör leveranserna ovan.
Dokumentation och överlämning till teamet vid uppdragets slut.

Vem vi söker

Du har gärna 5 år eller mer som backendutvecklare med erfarenhet av DevOps, som infrastrukturingenjör eller i liknande roll, framför allt i Azure-miljöer (erfarenhet av AWS är meriterande). Kollarnas backend är skriven i C# .NET och frontend i TypeScript/React. Erfarenhet av TypeScript och/eller Python är meriterande.

Du kan drifta Azure-tjänster med hjälp av exempelvis GitHub Actions, har god erfarenhet av databaser och SQL, framför allt MS SQL, och vet hur man bäst utnyttjar Azure-tjänster och sätter upp exempelvis Redis. Du har erfarenhet av att sätta upp och underhålla monitorering, tänker säkerhet först och har gedigen kunskap om hur man skyddar infrastruktur mot intrång.

Du är van att driva uppdrag självständigt och leverera mot överenskomna mål, samarbetar gärna och har erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt. Du talar och skriver flytande svenska och engelska.

Varför uppdraget är intressant

Kollarna är en tjänst som hjälper människor varje dag, och infrastrukturen bakom den behöver vara säker, stabil och skalbar. Här får du ett tydligt avgränsat uppdrag med verklig effekt, stort mandat inom ditt område och ett engagerat team att samarbeta med.

Uppdragsvillkor

Uppdragsform:
Direktuppdrag. Du fakturerar via eget bolag med F-skatt, helst aktiebolag.

Uppdragslängd:
Enligt överenskommelse.

Omfattning:
40 timmar per vecka.

Start:
Så snart som möjligt. Vi tar hänsyn till eventuella pågående uppdrag.

Arbetsplats:
Uppdraget utförs delvis på plats i Göteborg (Första Långgatan 18) för samarbete och avstämningar, enligt överenskommelse.

Ersättning:
Enligt överenskommelse. Ange gärna ditt timpris i ansökan.

Övrigt:
Uppdraget kan kombineras med andra uppdrag, så länge det inte innebär en intressekonflikt.

Var med och gör skillnad i vården!

Som en del av vår urvalsprocess genomför vi ID-kontroll och begär utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Vi söker konsulter som vill arbeta direkt med oss och ber därför vänligt men bestämt att konsultmäklare, konsultbolag och rekryteringsföretag avstår från att kontakta oss.

På Doktor.Se vill vi göra saker annorlunda. Vi vill utmana och förändra en hel bransch. Allt började med en idé om att det måste gå att skapa en vårdlösning som är bättre anpassad till vår tid och våra behov. Att det måste gå att få moderna digitala verktyg och traditionell fysisk vård att samverka med utgångspunkt i patientens behov. Och att göra det så att det inte bara blir tillgängligt för våra patienter utan också bidrar till att utveckla det sätt som vård erbjuds på idag. För oss alla. Det här är faktiskt vad vi gör idag. Men vi är långt ifrån klara och är ute på en spännande förändringsresa. Där kan du få vara med och bidra.

jobs.title: Junior German-speaking Fullstack Developer – Integration Team
jobs.description:
About Parkster

At Parkster, we want to be the best at what we do. We build smart, user-friendly software, strive for top-tier customer service, and strive to be a fantastic employer. We have offices in Lund and Munich, and our services are live in around 1,400 locations across Sweden, Germany, and Austria, used by hundreds of thousands of people every day.

This doesn’t stop us from chasing ambitious growth targets, quite the opposite. Together with municipalities, property owners, and private partners, we create parking solutions that are seamless today and sustainable for tomorrow.

Our engineering team currently counts just over 20 people. Many of us have years of experience, but nobody has lost the drive to solve tough problems and learn new things together.

About The Role

We have just launched a brand-new team dedicated entirely to our product integrations. These are the connections we build or configure alongside our customers and partners. Some of the most common examples are automatic license plate recognition (ANPR) cameras, EV charging, and data/statistics collection.

Initially, the team's hands-on focus will be building the integrations needed right now. Long-term, the goal is to empower others to quickly and easily configure standard integrations on their own, without needing to involve developers.

The same applies to monitoring the health of our existing integrations. To start with, you will dive in to investigate and resolve ongoing issues. We have already started visualizing this data and will set up smart alerting so that the right information reaches the right person at the right time. It’s going to be an exciting journey!

We are looking for a Junior Fullstack Developer with a solid technical foundation, high drive, and a good commercial mindset to join this team.

We are based out of our Lund office and truly value the sense of community at our workplace. While you have the flexibility to work from home a day or two a week, we hope you appreciate face-to-face collaboration and casual chats by the coffee machine just as much as we do!

Who Are You?

To thrive in this role, we believe you are someone who:

Has a solid technical foundation. Our systems are large and complex. To get up to speed, you need a broad technical baseline and a genuine desire to understand how things work under the hood. An appropriate foundation is either a masters in a related field, and/or at least two years of working experience as a developer.
Enjoys working with both people and machines. Integrations always involve another party, so it matters that you enjoy meeting potential customers and partners, both in person and online, and that you don't mind picking up the phone to get an answer or push an implementation forward.
Focuses on business value and user impact. We love building top-class technical solutions, but we always prioritize what creates the most value. The ability to evaluate, prioritize, and adjust your focus is crucial.
Is always curious to learn. You happily share your knowledge and actively seek feedback from your peers to keep growing.
You speak German and English (Swedish is a plus too!). A major part of our new integrations will be set up with partners in Germany and Austria, so you need to be able to effortlessly participate in and drive meetings with German speakers. Additionally, while our engineering language is English, our Lund office breathes Swedish, so if you can handle the daily fika chat or are eager to learn, you'll fit right in!

What We Work With

We don't hold any prestige when it comes to specific programming languages, we simply choose the best tool for the job. Today, our daily life looks roughly like this:

Backend: Java and Kotlin with Spring Boot.
Frontend: TypeScript, React, and Next.js (we also have Web Components and some legacy JSP).
Platform/Infrastructure: Kubernetes on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Databases: BigQuery, MongoDB, and MySQL, among others.

If you already know this stack, or if you have the drive and sharpness to pick it up quickly, you’ll love it here.

What We Offer

We are a team driven by building software that makes a real difference. Today, we are over a hundred colleagues across our offices in Sweden and Germany, enjoying close collaboration and a great community across borders and departments.

As an international growth company, we offer a fast-paced environment with plenty of room to grow. Here, you become part of a forward-thinking organization with short decision-making paths and a flat, ego-free culture.

Parkster offers great benefits, including an occupational pension, health insurance, a wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag), and above all, a workplace where we have serious fun at work.

Sounds like a match?

We recruit continuously and look forward to hearing from you. Send us your CV and a cover letter telling us a bit about what drives you.

Please note: Since it’s summertime, our response times might be a bit slower than usual over the holidays. We’ll be back in full force starting August 10th, and we appreciate your patience in the meantime!

Have any questions? Contact the hiring manager David Göransson via david.goransson@parkster.com or the Head of Development Martin Gunnarsson via martin.gunnarsson@parkster.com.

Wise IT söker en erfaren Manhattan Scale Consultant / Solution Architect för ett projektbaserat konsultuppdrag hos kund. Målet är att bedöma lösningens nuläge och molnberedskap, identifiera förbättringsområden samt lämna rekommendationer som stärker stabilitet, prestanda, skalbarhet och långsiktig förvaltningsbarhet.

Du kommer att granska den övergripande lösningsarkitekturen och bedöma designen utifrån etablerade arbetssätt. I ansvaret ingår att identifiera arkitekturella risker, teknisk skuld och onödiga anpassningar samt utvärdera lösningens skalbarhet, motståndskraft, förvaltningsbarhet och operativa stabilitet. Du tar även fram rekommendationer kring arkitekturella förbättringar och modernisering.

En central del av uppdraget är att analysera integrationerna mellan Manhattan Scale och omgivande system, däribland Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, EDI, API:er, middleware, transportsystem och andra verksamhetsapplikationer. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Bli med på laget og vær med på å forme fremtidens subsea-sensorteknologi!

Hos Siemens Energy på Bømlo vil du arbeide med avanserte sensorsystemer som støtter kritisk energiinfrastruktur. Som en del av et tverrfaglig ingeniørteam vil du utvikle programvare innen innebygde systemer, produksjonsverktøy, automatisering og digitale løsninger som har direkte innvirkning på hvordan produktene våre utvikles, produseres og brukes.

En glimt av din hverdag

Vi utvikler programvare og hardware som optimaliserer produksjonsprosessene våre. Dette inkluderer automatisering, logging, testsystemer og datadrevne forbedringer av prosesser.

Du vil få muligheten til å lære hvordan hele systemet fungerer, fra innebygd programvare og sensorhardware til backend-tjenester og frontend-applikasjoner. Nysgjerrighet og læringsvilje er minst like viktig som tidligere erfaring.

I hverdagen vil du jobbe på tvers av fagområder og ha tett samarbeid med produksjonen, hardwareingeniører og andre interne interessenter. Derfor er det viktig med fysisk tilstedeværelse på arbeidsplassen. Hjemmekontor er mulig i noe grad, men dette er primært en stilling med arbeidssted på Bømlo.

Hvordan du vil gjøre en forskjell

Innebygd programvare for subsea-sensorer

Utvikling i C og tilhørende verktøy. Programvaren kjører direkte på sensorene våre og er avgjørende for produktenes ytelse og pålitelighet.

Interne administrasjons- og automatiseringsløsninger

Vi utvikler og vedlikeholder interne systemer, inkludert et egenutviklet ERP-system og løsninger for dokumenthåndtering. Disse systemene integreres med plattformer som SAP og Teamcenter og bidrar til digitalisering på tvers av organisasjonen.

Produksjonsverktøy og digitalisering av fabrikken

Programvaren du utvikler bidrar til å sikre kvalitet, pålitelighet og ytelse i avansert subsea-sensorteknologi som brukes over hele verden.

Vår teknologistack inkluderer blant annet C, C#, TypeScript (Svelte), Rust og tilhørende rammeverk.

Hva du bringer med deg

Vi ser etter en ingeniør som:

Kan programmere selvstendig
Har et solid fundament innen programmering og programvareutvikling
Tar eierskap til oppgaver og følger dem helt i mål
Kommuniserer tydelig og samarbeider godt med både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter
Er nysgjerrig og ønsker å lære på tvers av fagområder
Arbeider strukturert og følger etablerte programvareprosesser

Utdanning innen informatikk, programvareutvikling eller tilsvarende er en fordel, men relevant erfaring og praktiske ferdigheter verdsettes like høyt.

Erfaringsnivå

Stillingen er rettet mot erfarne ingeniører. Samtidig er vi åpne for å investere i dyktige junioringeniører som ønsker å bygge en langsiktig karriere hos oss og gradvis ta større ansvar.

Hvem er Siemens Energy?
Hos Siemens Energy er vi mer enn bare et energiteknologiselskap. Med omtrent +100 000 dedikerte ansatte i mer enn 90 land utvikler vi energisystemene for fremtiden, og sikrer at det økende energibehovet til det globale samfunnet blir møtt på en pålitelig og bærekraftig måte. Teknologiene som skapes i våre forskningsavdelinger og fabrikker driver energiovergangen og utgjør grunnlaget for en sjettedel av verdens elektrisitetsproduksjon.

Vårt globale team er forpliktet til å gjøre bærekraftig, pålitelig og rimelig energi til en realitet ved å presse grensene for hva som er mulig. Vi opprettholder et 150-års arv av innovasjon som oppmuntrer vår søken etter mennesker som vil støtte vårt fokus på avkarbonisering, nye teknologier og energitransformasjon.

Finn ut hvordan du kan gjøre en forskjell hos Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Vår forpliktelse til mangfoldet
Skap energi. Vær deg selv.

Heldigvis for oss, er vi ikke alle like. Gjennom mangfold, inkludering og respekt skaper vi energi. Vår samlede kreative energi kommer fra mer enn 130 nasjoner. Siemens Energy verdsetter deg og den du er, uavhengig av din etniske bakgrunn, kjønn, alder, religion, identitet eller funksjonsnivå. Vi skaper energi til samfunnet, hele samfunnet, og vi gjør ikke forskjell på folk.

Vi utfører bakgrunnssjekk som del av vår rekrutteringsprosess.

to help design and deliver production-grade AI solutions for enterprise customers. This is a hands-on architecture role for someone who understands both the technical depth of modern AI systems and the practical realities of deploying them securely, reliably, and at scale.

You will work across LLM applications, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, classical machine learning, cloud-native platforms, and responsible AI governance. The right candidate knows when to use generative AI, when traditional ML is the better fit, and how to design solutions that are robust, compliant, maintainable, and aligned with business needs.

This role also requires strong customer-facing skills. You should be able to explain complex AI concepts and architectures clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, contribute to RFPs and proposals, and help customers understand how AI can solve real business problems.

What You’ll Be Working On

Designing and delivering enterprise AI solutions using LLMs, RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector search, classical ML, and agentic architectures.
Building applications where AI systems can reason, plan, use tools, retrieve knowledge, and support complex business workflows.
Shaping scalable AI architectures across platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS, GCP, and multi-cloud environments.
Establishing best practices for MLOps and LLMOps, including CI/CD, evaluation, observability, monitoring, model governance, and lifecycle management.
Helping customers make informed platform and architecture choices based on security, compliance, data residency, scalability, and business value.
Contributing to Vivicta’s AI capabilities, including our work with secure, compliant, and sovereign AI environments.
Embedding responsible AI principles into every solution, with attention to GDPR, the EU AI Act, enterprise security requirements, and customer-specific governance frameworks.
Creating reusable reference architectures, technical accelerators, and delivery practices that help teams build AI solutions faster and more consistently.
Supporting sales, pre-sales, and proposal work by translating customer needs into credible AI solution concepts, architectures, and delivery plans.
Acting as a senior advisor to customers, delivery teams, and technical stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For

Strong communication skills in both Finnish and English. This is required for customer-facing work.
At least 8 years of experience in AI, machine learning, data platforms, cloud architecture, or software architecture roles.
A strong track record of designing and delivering production-ready AI or data-driven systems.
Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience building AI-enabled applications.
Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, evaluation, and AI application development.
Experience with agentic frameworks or orchestration patterns, such as Pydantic AI, Vercel AI SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent approaches.
Strong expertise in at least one major cloud AI/ML platform, such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI.
Good understanding of MLOps, LLMOps, model evaluation, monitoring, observability, and production operations.
Ability to design end-to-end architectures, evaluate trade-offs, document decisions, and guide teams from concept to production.
Ability to explain technical concepts, solution architectures, risks, and business value clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience contributing to sales, pre-sales, RFP responses, proposals, workshops, or customer presentations.
Understanding of security, privacy, compliance, data residency, and responsible AI requirements in enterprise environments.
Interest in sovereign AI, secure AI platforms, and emerging enterprise AI operating models.

Why this role matters

This role is about more than building AI models or prototypes. It is about helping enterprises adopt AI responsibly, securely, and at scale.

As an AI Architect at Vivicta, you will influence how Nordic enterprises design and deploy AI systems that create real business value. You will help customers move from experimentation to production, shape future-ready AI platforms, and contribute to the development of secure, compliant, and scalable AI capabilities.

You will be part of a team working at the intersection of architecture, engineering, cloud platforms, governance, customer advisory, and business transformation.

We offer you

We offer you professional growth, meaningful work, open culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We offer you an opportunity to create the future of a growing, fast-developing, and important sector. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.

Did we get you inspired?

We look forward to your application!

Please attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile and we will reach out to you. Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today. Hope to hear from you soon!

We conduct background checks for all final candidates, and some roles may require security clearance during hiring or later—always handled within local legislation and with care and confidentiality.

Vivicta is committed to diversity and welcomes applicants of all genders, ages, abilities, ethnicities, orientations, beliefs, and backgrounds. 

Vivicta declines calls from recruitment companies.

jobs.title: Value Architect, Data & AI
jobs.description:
A senior data and AI expert who turns data into value: advising our key clients, shaping our offering, and helping grow the business.

Do you enjoy working with modern data & AI solutions? Are you equally at home acting as a trusted advisor to clients while driving sales and shaping the offering? If your answer is yes, then we are looking for you, Value Architect, to join our growing Data & AI Studio.

At Nortal, we build solutions and services that bring real value to users and society as a whole. In Finland, we have nearly 200 employees, and internationally we operate in over 20 countries. Our Data & AI Studio brings together strategy, engineering, and AI to help organizations turn data into real business value, from discovery to scalable, production-grade solutions.

As a Value Architect in our Data & AI Studio, you are a senior subject-matter expert working across two roughly equal dimensions of the role. One half is client-facing. You act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on where unified data and AI-first delivery turn cost into advantage, which investments return the most in time-to-value, quality, and decision speed, and which human-and-AI team should deliver them. The other half builds the offering and the pipeline. You shape what we sell, architect the sale, and support our teams to win, and you may take ownership of specific offerings of your own. One morning you frame the business case with a CDO. That afternoon you review a data architecture with the engineers who will build it.

The offering you will work with and shape

Everything we do runs on an AI-first approach: a spec-driven, agentic operating model where a small embedded team owns the product lifecycle end to end. The Nortal AI Kit sits underneath it, with skills, templates, workflows, and agents that turn business ideas and needs into AI-ready specifications, and those into enterprise-grade platforms, data products, and AI applications. This is not a separate service. It is how we deliver, and it runs through each of our core offerings:
Data & AI Platform Modernization:
unified, governed data and AI foundations that make data AI-ready at scale, delivered for example as a Databricks or Microsoft Fabric lakehouse and an AI platform such as Microsoft AI Foundry or M365 Copilot.
Edge Platform Modernization:
unified, cloud-native, edge architecture for real-time, sovereign data and AI across many sites from one control plane, compliant by design and delivered for example as Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes at the edge.
Data, AI & Analytics use cases:
data, AI, and analytics applied to business processes to create value. Built on the data and edge platforms, these use cases turn trusted, unified data into measurable outcomes: higher uptime and throughput, sharper demand and risk forecasting, lower energy use and cost, better customer targeting, and safer, more compliant operations.

You start with these, help evolve them, and shape new offerings as the market moves.

What You Will Do

The role has two roughly equal sides.

Advise our clients and protect the value
Be the trusted advisor
. Work with senior client stakeholders (CDOs, heads of data, business owners) to connect their priorities to data and AI outcomes, and shape strategies and roadmaps they can act on.
Own the architecture.
Influence architecture and design decisions so solutions scale and stay governed, secure, and compliant. You need not ship every pipeline yourself, but you can steer an AI-first approach and stand behind the design.
Stay through delivery.
Don’t hand off after the sale. Stay hands-on enough to protect the architecture, data governance, quality, and the value case from proposal to production.

Build the offering and win the work
Support sales.
Lead discovery and qualification (backlog size, handovers per request, time-to-delivery, platform readiness), handle the hard objections with evidence, and shape the proposal, including the solution approach, the work estimate (often AI-augmented), and the customer value case. Always close on a concrete next step, whether a workshop, a discovery project, or full-scale delivery.
Develop the offering
. Turn engagements into reusable assets and named offerings, sharpen the land-and-expand packaging, and feed proof points, patterns, and prompts back into the offering.
Help us grow.
Support growing the business, take ownership of selected offerings, mentor others, and help run AI-aware delivery teams, so growth is never bound by one person’s bandwidth.

What We Hope You Bring

A senior background in data and technology with business acumen
(Data Architect, Principal Consultant, Head of Data or Analytics, Solution Lead, or similar), with ten or more years across both the customer and consulting sides.
A track record of winning new, high-value customers
and engagements and growing existing accounts, with real ownership of business growth, not just delivery.
Consultative mindset.
You lead with the customer’s problem, not with technology. You listen, frame the real question, and guide senior stakeholders to a decision they own. Enterprise architecture skills and experience are a strong asset here, connecting business strategy, operating model, data, and technology into one coherent picture.
AI-native ways of working.
Fluent use of modern AI tools (such as Claude Cowork, Claude Design) and coding agents (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, Kiro). You work AI-first by habit, not by exception.
Platform familiarity.
Comfortable with modern cloud and data stacks such as Databricks and Microsoft Fabric. Relevant certifications are a plus.
Value-case construction.
An instinct for where AI and unified data remove cost rather than shift it, and the ability to turn that into a case a CFO and a CDO both believe. A commercial mindset, and ownership of your pipeline.
Domain depth.
Working knowledge of at least one industry we serve (manufacturing, energy, the public sector, retail, or similar) is a strong plus, and helps you speak the customer’s language from day one.
Communication.
Strong spoken, written, and presentation skills in Finnish and English, with the ability to reach both technical teams and C-level stakeholders. German is an asset.

Why join us

Shape it, don’t inherit it.
You help build and grow the offering alongside the Head of Data & AI, rather than maintaining one someone else froze in place. It is an evolving, entrepreneurial role with room to leave your mark.
Work at the AI-first frontier.
Agentic, spec-driven data delivery and platform modernization applied to real enterprise problems, not perpetual pilots.
A community, not a silo.
A network of architects from several disciplines and transformation consultants behind you, and delivery teams who can actually ship what you sell.
Sell from strength.
Own your pipeline and your patterns, with the weight of a trusted partner to governments and Fortune 500 companies across Europe, the GCC, Latin America, and North America. Microsoft named us in its Industrial AI Partner Guide, one of a select group of integrators trusted to deliver industrial AI at scale.

Salary range
: 7000-9000€ / month (full-time). Final compensation will depend on factors such as relevant experience, role seniority, and skill set.

Please note that we will begin reviewing applications in week 31.

Nortal values equality and diversity in our work community. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, such as in regard to age, gender, culture or minority group.

jobs.title: Erfaren C#/.NET-udvikler til opbygning af integrationsplatform
jobs.description:
Har du solid erfaring med C#, .NET og udvikling af integrationer i Azure? Kan du omsætte tekniske krav og arkitekturprincipper til robust kode, veldesignede API’er og løsninger, der fungerer stabilt i drift? Så kan du blive vores nye kollega.

Du får en central teknisk rolle i udviklingen af Roskilde Universitets Azure-baserede integrationsplatform. Du skal udvikle integrationer og fælles komponenter samt bidrage til en robust og sammenhængende applikations- og integrationsarkitektur. Samtidig får du mulighed for at fastlægge teamets standarder for kode, unittest og dokumentation inden for vores fælles arkitekturprincipper og i dialog med teamet. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med teamets øvrige udviklere, faglig koordinator og testmanager samt med arkitekter, drift og projektledere.

Roskilde Universitet er i gang med en omfattende digital modernisering. Vi udskifter og opgraderer centrale systemer og flytter løbende integrationer til en fælles integrationsplatform. Det stiller krav til robuste API’er, genanvendelige komponenter, sikker dataudveksling og løsninger, der kan overvåges, driftes og videreudvikles.

Om Digital og dit team

Du bliver en del af Digitaliseringsenheden med 16 medarbejdere. Enheden hører under Digital, Roskilde Universitets centrale afdeling for IT, digitalisering, informationssikkerhed, samt projekt- og procesmetoder. Digital har ca. 70 medarbejdere.

Din daglige base bliver udviklingsteamet, som består af fem udviklere, en fagkoordinator samt en testmanager. Teamet deltager i udviklingsprojekter og varetager samtidig den løbende vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling af universitetets systemer, integrationer og platforme.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine hovedopgaver i jobbet er at: Udvikle og vedligeholde integrationer, fælles komponenter og referenceimplementeringer på vores integrationsplatform.
Omsætte behov, krav og arkitekturprincipper til tekniske designs og robuste løsninger samt videreudvikle principperne for udviklingsområdet i samarbejde med teamet og arkitekterne.
Fastlægge og forankre teamets udviklingsprincipper og standarder samt løfte den tekniske kvalitet gennem code reviews, automatiseret test, dokumentation, faglig sparring og videndeling.
Videreudvikle vores CI/CD-pipelines og automatisere build, test og deployment.
Bidrage gennem hele DevOps-forløbet fra analyse og udvikling til idriftsættelse, overvågning og fejlhåndtering.
Anvende og videreudvikle teamets brug af AI-baserede udviklingsværktøjer til kodning, test, dokumentation og fejlsøgning.

Kvalifikationer

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for IT, softwareudvikling eller lignende. Du kan også have opbygget tilsvarende kompetencer gennem flere års relevant erhvervserfaring.
Vi forventer at du har: Solid erfaring med C#, moderne .NET og objektorienteret softwareudvikling.
Erfaring med design, udvikling og deployment af integrationer i Azure, gerne med Azure Functions og App Service.
Erfaring med API’er, dataflows og datakontrakter samt databaser, SQL, JSON og XML.
Erfaring med Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD-pipelines og automatiserede unit- og integrationstest.
Evne til at omsætte krav og arkitekturprincipper til robuste løsninger, begrunde tekniske valg og dokumentere kode, snitflader og tekniske beslutninger.
Erfaring med AI-understøttet softwareudvikling og evne til at kvalitetssikre værktøjernes kode og forslag.
Lyst til at dele viden og løfte den tekniske kvalitet sammen med resten af teamet.
Derudover er det en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med flere af følgende områder
Eventbaserede integrationer og robuste meddelelsesmønstre, herunder idempotens.
Containerbaserede løsninger og IAC, f.eks. Docker eller Terraform,
Identitets- og adgangsstyring i Azure, herunder Entra ID, Managed Identities, Key Vault eller OAuth 2.0.
Entity Framework, GraphQL

Vi lægger vægt på, at du arbejder struktureret, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og kan sætte dig ind i komplekse tekniske problemstillinger. Du samarbejder konstruktivt på tværs af fagligheder og kan forklare tekniske valg til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske kolleger. Du skal kunne formulere dig på dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelse og aflønning sker efter overenskomst for akademikere i staten med indplacering efter gældende overenskomst som specialkonsulent eller anden relevant overenskomst. Der er herudover mulighed for at forhandle tillæg. Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen med ansættelse 1. december eller snarest herefter.

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i uge 43 og 44.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at henvende dig til enhedschef Sonni Hansen på +45 6195 1227 eller sonni@ruc.dk.

Jf. direktivet om løngennemsigtighed fremgår lønintervallerne for de forskellige jobkategorier på Roskilde Universitet her.

Ansøgning

Søg stillingen på https://ruc.dk/ledige-stillinger-pa-roskilde-universitet/
Ansøgningen skal indeholde:

1. Motiveret ansøgning
2. CV
3. Dokumentation for uddannelse

Ansøgningsfristen er 14. oktober2026.

Materiale modtaget efter fristens udløb vil ikke blive taget i betragtning.

jobs.title: Developer
jobs.description:
Du bliver en del af Professional Services (PS) – vores forretningsenhed, der arbejder med digitalisering og teknologiske løsninger inden for ERP, CRM, Microsoft 365, Business Intelligence, Cyber Consultancy, Custom Built Solutions og AI.

I forretningsområdet Custom Built Solutions vil du indgå i vores Products-team, der udvikler og driver Danmarks førende elektroniske patientjournalsystem til den kommunale tandpleje. Vi søger en full-stack Developer med særligt fokus på frontend-udvikling. Samtidig skal du blive motiveret af at arbejde med videreudvikling og forbedring af et veletableret system, som hver dag understøtter arbejdet i den kommunale tandpleje i samarbejde med dygtige kollegaer.

Du bliver tilknyttet vores kontor i Viby eller Nordhavn med mulighed for hjemmearbejde. Du kan dog forvente periodisk mødeaktivitet på begge lokationer.

Din rolle

Som Developer kommer du til at arbejde med videreudvikling og vedligeholdelse af vores system til den kommunale tandpleje. Rollen har primært fokus på frontend-udvikling og integrationer til øvrige systemer, men du kommer også til at være involveret i prioritering af produktudvikling, test, fejlsøgning og dokumentation sammen med resten af det stærke team omkring produktet. Du vil få et tæt samarbejde med resten af teamet bl.a. bestående af produktkonsulenter, supportere og andre udviklere, hvor alle har et stærkt ønske om at forbedre og styrke systemets funktionaliteter og sikre glade kunder. Vi løfter i fællesskab, og derfor er det væsentligt, at du er en holdspiller.

Derudover kan rollen også indebære dialog og sparring med kunder – både over for tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du trives i rollen som sparringspartner og kan omsætte og formidle tekniske løsninger i et sprog, der giver mening for brugerne og for dine kollegaer i teamet.

Dine primære ansvarsområder dækker over følgende:

Afdække kundernes forretningsbehov og omsætte dem til tekniske løsninger og systemfunktioner.
Fejlsøge og forbedre eksisterende integrationer for at sikre stabil dataudveksling.
Udvikle nye frontend-funktioner til systemet.
Vedligeholde og optimere eksisterende kodebase for at sikre stabil drift og høj performance.
Bidrage til teknisk sparring i forbindelse med design af nye funktioner.
Udarbejde og gennemføre tests af nye funktioner og integrationer.
Udarbejde teknisk dokumentation af nye funktioner, integrationer og systemændringer.

Vi søger en teamm8 der

Ønsker en rolle med fokus på både nyudvikling og vedligeholdelse af et anerkendt system inden for et nicheområde. Derudover ser vi gerne at følgende er opfyldt:

3-5 års erfaring fra en rolle som udvikler særligt med fokus på frontend-udvikling, hvor du eventuelt har arbejdet med Middleware, Unit-testing og/eller CI/CD.
Gerne viden om WinForms, .Net Framework/.Net Core, SQL Server, Git og/eller Azure DevOps.
Evner at forklare kompleks kode i et sprog som kollegaer og kunder forstår.
Motiveres i kundedialoger og behovsafdækning, som herefter omsættes til konkrete løsninger.
Behersker dansk og engelsk både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Det du får

En unik mulighed for at arbejde med softwareudvikling i et nichesystem, der er anerkendt i markedet.
Mulighed for tage ansvar i en udviklingsrolle af teknisk karakter, hvor du formår at spille systemets brugere gode med rette rådgivning.
At blive en del af en hybrid arbejdsplads med mulighed for hjemmearbejde.

jobs.title: DevOps-medarbejder til .NET løsninger
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med IT i en styrelse, der arbejder med hele fødevarekæden fra jord til bord under politisk og mediemæssig bevågenhed? Vil du være med til at udvikle og vedligeholde styrelsens It- og forretningssystemer og bidrage til at sikre brugervenlige og sammenhængende digitale løsninger samt effektive arbejdsgange? Vil du være en del af vores digitale transformation og arbejde efter agile metoder? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i IT-systemvedligehold og drift i Fødevarestyrelsen.

Fødevarestyrelsen søger en DevOps-medarbejder med erfaring og kompetencer inden for Azure-miljøet til IT-enheden, hvor man kommer til at stå midt i en spændende udvikling hen imod en moderne IT-platform i tæt samarbejde mellem udvikling og drift.

Vores digitale transformation er i gang

Fødevarestyrelsen skal med brugernes behov i centrum videreudvikle og forny IT-understøttelsen af en stor del af vores kerneforretning. Derfor står vi midt i et spændende og udfordrende forløb, som du vil blive en del af.

Som et led i dette, har vi et stigende behov for at forbedre vores arbejdsgange omkring løbende udvikling og idriftsættelse. Vi har både nyere og ældre applikationer, og har både behov for at få løftet driften af de ældre løsninger, men også behov for løbende at idriftsætte og udvikle nye løsninger.

Du kommer til at være et teknisk bindeled imellem IT-enhedens drifts- og udviklingsteams. Sammen med andre kollegaer vil du sørge for, at applikationer løbende udvikles, deployeres og patches.

Om jobbet

Som DevOps-medarbejder bliver du en vigtig del af arbejdet med at sikre stabile driftsløsninger og understøtte den fortsatte udvikling af styrelsens IT-landskab. Du bliver det tekniske bindeled mellem drift og udvikling og får en central rolle i vores Azure-miljø.

Du vil således både indgå i den daglige drift men også i de agile arbejdsgange omkring nye it-leverancer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være at: Drift, overvågning og vedligeholdelse af styrelsens IT-systemer
Automatisere drifts- og deployeringsprocesser
Samarbejde tæt med udviklere og leverandører om idriftsættelse og vedligeholdelse af løsninger
Fejlsøge, dokumentere og indgå i beredskabsopgaver efter behov
Bidrage til IT-sikkerhed, compliance og stabile driftsprocesser
Være IT-driftens ankerperson på Azure-miljøet

Om dig – vores nye kollega

Vi søger en ny kollega med solid teknologiforståelse og som har erfaring med: Azure DevOps og Azure Pipelines
Har erfaring med it-drift, særligt i relation til DevOps
CI/CD og automatisering af deployments
Drift og administration af Azure-miljøer

Vi lægger derudover vægt på, at du: Er nysgerrig på ny teknologi og gerne vil dele viden – både når du skal modtage og give videre
Har erfaring med systemadministration af større enterprice løsninger.
Trives med bredt ansvar og varierende opgaver
Har godt kendskab til forskellige deployværktøjer
Arbejder struktureret, og har forståelse for drift i en offentlig/statslig kontekst
har erfaring med SCRUM, agile og SAFe.
Har en uddannelse som f.eks. datamatatiker, itteknolog, datalog eller ingeniør – men vi er åbne over for en anden faglig baggrund

Kendskab til disse teknologier er en fordel:
Microsoft .NET Core, Microsoft IIS, Microsoft SQL, Microsoft Server, Microsoft EntraID og tenant administration.
Grafana

Om Fødevarestyrelsens IT

IT-enheden består af tre sektioner, der arbejder tæt sammen. Samlet set er vi ca. 45 medarbejdere. Stillingen er placeret i IT-systemvedligehold og -drift, som består af 17 medarbejdere. Vi samarbejder tæt med Statens IT, hvilket giver mulighed for at udvikle kompetencer inden for leverandørstyring. Vi stræber efter at opretholde en høj faglig standard, som gør det muligt for os at udfordre vores leverandører gennem en solid IT-faglig dialog.

Fordele og goder

Vi tilbyder fleksible arbejdstider, mulighed for hjemmearbejde, efteruddannelse og deltagelse i sociale arrangementer. Vi har et stærkt fokus på medarbejdertrivsel og arbejder i et innovativt og samarbejdsorienteret miljø.

Udviklingsmuligheder

Der er rig mulighed for karriereudvikling og efteruddannelse inden for organisationen. Vi støtter dine professionelle mål og tilbyder et miljø, hvor du kan vokse og udvikle dig.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker efter relevant statslig overenskomst.

Har du en akademisk uddannelse, vil du blive ansat efter den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Skatteministeriet og en række AC-organisationer, og du vil som udgangspunkt blive ansat som fuldmægtig.

Afhængig af din erfaring og dine kvalifikationer, kan der ske ansættelse som specialkonsulent.

Har du en ikke-akademisk uddannelse, vil du blive ansat efter den relevante gældende overenskomst.

Ansættelsesområdet er Fødevarestyrelsen, og tjenestestedet er IT-enheden, Stationsparken 31-33, 2600 Glostrup.

Tiltrædelsestidspunkt:

Der er brug for dig snarest muligt og gerne den 1. december 2026.

Din ansøgning

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, CV, kopi af eksamensbevis og andre relevante bilag via vores online rekrutteringssystem senest den 15. oktober 2026.

Vi vil gerne bede om, at du i din ansøgning beskriver:
* Dine erfaringer med DevOps, herunder automatisering, CI/CD-processer og drift af løsninger i Azure.
* Et konkret eksempel på, hvordan du har samarbejdet på tværs af drift og udvikling for at sikre stabile og effektive leverancer.

Vi holder samtaler i løbet af uge 43 på vores adresse i Glostrup.

Vil du vide mere?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingsopslaget, er du velkommen til at kontakte den ansvarlige sektionsleder Nicolai på 72 27 68 08.

Læs mere om at arbejde i Fødevarestyrelsen på www.fvst.dk/job.

Det er en betingelse for ansættelsen, at du som led i din ansættelse, kan:
* Opnå gyldig arbejds- opholdstilladelse i Danmark inden tiltrædelse eller
* Opnå gyldigt opholdsdokument i Danmark ved ansættelse.

Fødevarestyrelsen betragter mangfoldighed som et aktiv og opfordrer alle uanset personlig baggrund til at søge.

jobs.title: Senior Unity Tools Developer (Core Tech)
jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Do you feel like the tools that make a game are more interesting than the game itself?

As our new Senior Unity Tools Developer, you’ll join our Core Tech team building and maintaining the shared tools and packages that power everything we make, from hands and cars to horses and beyond.

Your focus will be on making great internal tools: creating solid, well-documented packages, improving our testing and automation setup, and jumping in when Unity issues need debugging.

Here’s what your job looks like day to day

Building and maintaining Unity tools like automation, localization, or game data (with great documentation and a strong “others will use this” mindset)
Helping debug and troubleshoot issues in Unity (editor and runtime)
Collaborating with other team members on new packages
Improving the overall game development experience for everyone through better workflows, reliability, and clarity in our shared tools

Must-haves

Proficiency in C# and a deep knowledge of Unity tooling, including its asset pipeline
Experience shipping iOS and macOS apps with hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and CloudKit, using Xcode and Swift
Experience with performance optimization
Strong fundamentals in software design (e.g. unit testing, integration testing, dependency injection, design patterns)
A deep interest in tools development: you get more excited about building tooling and setting up efficient workflows than working directly on player-facing game features
An investigative mindset: you’re curious, thorough, and enjoy getting to the bottom of tricky problems
A genuine interest in sharing knowledge: you enjoy bringing people together, explaining how things work and helping them adopt tools

Nice-to-haves

Experience with automated testing of Unity projects, including on-device testing
Experience with graphics and shaders programming
Interest in experimenting with and using AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) in your day-to-day

Requirements For Any Job At Triband

You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward.
You're motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture.
You value a positive work environment and contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place.
You have team production experiences, such as using version control software (we use git), branching, stand-ups, sprints, and reviews.

Practicalities

We don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role.
We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.
We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.
No crunch. People over deadlines.
Our working language is English.

We offer

Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.
A professional development budget to invest in your growth.
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).
Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).
Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.
Pension plan and private health insurance.
Endless amounts of coffee.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

Key Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core
Work with PostgreSQL (via Npgsql/Entity Framework) to design schemas, write efficient queries, and manage data access layers
Implement and maintain authentication/authorization flows, including enterprise authentication and directory services integration
Integrate backend services with third-party and enterprise systems (e.g., ITSM platforms, directory services, internal enterprise APIs)
Collaborate with frontend engineers to design clean API contracts consumed by React/TypeScript applications
Containerize services with Docker and support CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI)
Write unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and uphold code quality standards (e.g., SonarQube)
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across the stack, with structured logging (log4net) and observability practices
Contribute to architecture decisions for new services and the evolution of existing ones

What We're Looking For

5+ years of professional experience building backend services in C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core preferred)
Strong understanding of REST API design, authentication/authorization patterns, and secure coding practices
Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar) and ORMs (Entity Framework or equivalent)
Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines
Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative development workflows
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work cross-functionally with frontend, QA, and infrastructure teams

Nice to Have (Advantages)

Full-stack development experience — comfort working across the stack with React/TypeScript front ends, from API design to UI integration
AI/ML knowledge — familiarity with applying AI/LLM tooling to developer workflows, automation, or product features (e.g., integrating LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or AI-assisted development practices)
Automation experience with Python and/or Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) — building or maintaining scripts, playbooks, or jobs for infrastructure automation, compliance checks, or operational tooling

Why Us?

Bank of America’s strategic vision is to deliver market-leading technology that drives our business forward and meets the needs of our clients. Our business-aligned technology teams develop and support the software platforms critical to that goal. These cover the full spectrum of our business including sales, trading and research applications, trade processing, risk management and portfolio management.

In order to maintain our competitive edge and deliver the best solutions to our global client base, we continually invest in cutting-edge technology, including artificial intelligence (AI). Global Technology embeds AI into how we build, run and protect our company’s platforms, reflecting a culture of responsible innovation. As a member of our team, you’ll use leading AI-enabled technology solutions and integrated platforms to help customers and clients manage their financial lives and bank with us anytime, anywhere. The global nature of our business offers you the opportunity to work and interact with colleagues from around the world, supporting an expanding product range and high level of global demand.

This Summer Analyst Program offers Software Engineer role in the Global Markets Technology divisions. This division provides technology solutions and strategic support to the equities, electronic trading, rates and currencies, credit and structured products, commodities, sales and capital markets businesses.

Global Markets Technology (GMT) – Provides technology solutions and support to Global Markets business. GMT includes Global Equity Technology - Leads the three primary businesses, active in 140 markets around the world: Execution Services (high and low touch), Client Solutions (derivatives) and Asset Management Services (prime brokerage, security lending and swaps). In addition, this group also covers Global Sales, Research, Capital Markets and the GBAM Mercury® Portal. Fixed Income, Currencies and Commodities (FICC) Technology - Supports FICC trading and sales franchise that operates out of 25 locations worldwide, covering clients in more than 150 countries. Global Markets Operations Technology - Supports Global Markets Operations and Middle Office, plus external partners. Acts as the primary support for Global Markets Operations across Transaction Management, Confirmations, Settlements & Clearing, Corporate Actions, Payments, Operational Risk, P&L and Balance Sheet, and Reference Data. They also provide support for Futures and Options, OTC Clearing, FXPB and GCAS Front Offices.

What you’ll do:

Key tasks and responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

Provide technical excellence to design, develop, and maintain state-of-the-art technology applications utilizing technologies such as Java/EJB’s, C++, .NET, Python and Web services
Gather and translate internal and external client requirements into technical design specifications, business process reengineering
Code solutions, unit tests, and ensures the solution can be integrated successfully into the overall application/system with clear, robust, and well-tested interfaces
Participates and contributes to the delivery/release (CI/CD) events. e.g. branching timelines, pull requests, issue triage, merge/conflict resolution, release notes

Program Overview

Our Summer Program is a 10-week program designed to provide you with a unique experience based on your interests, development opportunities and current business needs. Analyst positions support teams that work on the latest technology and emerging technical trends. The Summer program begins with an orientation and induction to the firm. You will have access to valuable on-the-job support, opportunities to connect with senior leaders and the ability to attend various networking and developmental events.

Summer Analysts are given a true associate experience, as assignments mirror full-time responsibility and include goal-setting and a formal review process.

Your internship opportunity could include:

Access to the bank’s learning hub containing a variety of learning resources, ranging from banking fundamentals to communication skills
Structured and on-the-job training
Networking and social opportunities
Speaker series with senior management across all lines of business
Corporate Social Responsibility project/learning
Involvement in Opportunity and Inclusion training/events
Consideration for full-time employment upon graduation

One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being an inclusive workplace for everyone.
