jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern (Jan to Jun 2027)
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

What You'll Do

Project scope/overview:

The intern will design, develop, and deploy production-ready capabilities for Airwallex’s Spend Cards and Issuing platform. The project may span card lifecycle management, spend controls, transaction visibility, APIs, or customer-facing card experiences..

Detailed Outline

Technical tasks/deliverables:

Technical design scoping: Create workflow diagrams, identify dependencies, expected inputs and outputs, and define success criteria (e.g., latency, accuracy, cost).
Feature development: Build and integrate production-ready Cards and Issuing capabilities across backend, APIs, and frontend where needed.
Testing & observability: Add automated testing and set up observability dashboards with logging, metrics, and alerts to monitor performance and reliability.
Deployment: Deploy the completed capability to production and validate it with real users.

Project Milestones

Technical design sign-off: Finalise workflow diagrams, success criteria, and technical design documentation.
MVP development: Build Cards or Issuing capability and validate key flows.
Production readiness: Complete testing, observability, and integration requirements.
Deployment and showcase: Release the capability and present the outcome to the wider Engineering team.

Expected Learning

Card issuing concepts, including card lifecycle, spend controls, and transactions
API and distributed systems design
Production engineering including testing, observability, and reliability
Frontend for customer-facing experiences
Building within a global fintech platform

Planned Role & Responsibilities

Actively participate in team standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to align with engineering priorities.
Collaborate with cross-functional partners (e.g., Operations, Finance, Infosec) to understand workflow requirements and validate outputs.
Contribute to code reviews, testing, and documentation.
Deliver bi-weekly project updates and participate in mid-point and final showcases to demo project.
Design, develop, and deploy an assigned Cards or Issuing project under mentor guidance.

Outline Of Onboarding Process Steps In Team

Buddy assignment: Pair with a senior engineer/mentor for end-to-end feature lifecycle walkthrough, and weekly technical check-ins.
Tools orientation: Setup access to relevant AI and development tools
Domain familiarization: Walkthrough of identified finance operational workflows (e.g., cash reconciliation, PO approvals) with relevant domain experts

Proposed Schedule Of Review Check-ins

Monthly check-in for progress review and feedback sharing
Final Review: at 24 weeks (End-of-project showcase)

Eligibility Requirements

Able to commit to a 6 month placement period, ideally commence in Jan ‘27 through to June 2027.
Able to commit to Full Time hours for the duration of the placement.
Are a current student in Singapore, studying towards a formal tertiary qualification at a recognised university.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Desire to learn and grow with Airwallex as a technologist.

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum skills and experience for this role. The preferred skills are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum Skills & Experience

Proficiency in Python, with strong software engineering fundamentals.
Ability to design and implement AI-driven systems that automate workflows and improve customer experiences.
Strong skills in system design and critical thinking, building elegant abstractions over complex patterns, especially in financial services.
Proven track record of writing clean, high-quality, production-grade code and ensuring robust interactions between services.
Experience working with production AI systems, adhering to best practices in engineering, security, and AI governance.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner across technical and non-technical teams.

Preferred Skills & Experience

Proficiency in Kotlin, Typescript or Javascript.
Familiarity with MLOps practices and deployment pipelines for AI-driven products (e.g., model serving, monitoring, retraining).
Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Ray, etc.), or event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
Exposure to cloud AI/ML services (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including GPU orchestration and scalable model deployment.

Application and Assessment process

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis with application status changes and outcomes communicated as soon as decisions are finalised. Your patience during this process is highly appreciated.

Online technical assessment
Talent screen
Technical Interview
Hiring Manager interview

Requirements:
Please provide us with the PDF copies of your transcripts and CV outlining when you finish your studies when applying

About You

You can think on your feet - with knowledge of building platforms which resolve fast paced, ever changing success measures.
You are a team player - you enjoy working in a collaborative, innovative and customer first environment.
You are naturally curious - always asking why to better understand our customer needs.
You are a passionate problem solver - You love digging deep and brainstorming with colleagues in order to come up with the best solution for a problem

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Suvoda is a global clinical trial technology company shaping digital experiences that enable clinical trial sponsor and site professionals to take full command over the inherent logistical complexity behind mission-critical and time-sensitive patient interactions in life-sustaining studies for therapeutic areas such as oncology, central nervous system, and rare disease.

Supporting clinical trials means supporting unique experiments that are inherently complex, high-stakes, and dynamic. It is imperative that Suvoda staff working with clients, end-users, or the systems that client and end-users interact with understand the clinical trial industry, regulations, Suvoda’s software products and processes, and especially the specificities of the unique trial in question before taking any actions they may alter the data of the system in question.

Responsibilities

Work within a cross-functional project team to develop Interactive Response Technology (IRT) for randomization and drug supply management
Review user requirements specifications, verifying that all requirements can be implemented with the Suvoda software in the required timeframe
Assist with the creation of implementation design and technical design documentation
Develop software systems that are reliable, maintainable, and efficient, with emphasis on patient safety and integrity of clinical study data
Manage the deployment of Suvoda IRT systems into all environments, completing all required documentation
Assist the support team with troubleshooting and resolution of issues reported on production systems
Participate in the product research and development process by providing the engineering team with new solutions and ideas based on project experience
Generate ideas for innovative technological solutions to increase the quality of Suvoda system
Perform other related duties as required

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree preferred
At least 2 years of experience in a similar role
Prior working experience in developing web applications with C#, .NET (Framework or Core), SQL Server, Model View Controller (MVC) and Entity Framework (EF)
High achieving personality
Desire to learn and grow
Strong work ethic
Sense of ownership
Proactive attitude
Time management and organizational skills

Job Description

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior .NET Backend Developer to join our team!

We strongly believe that “Ideas power everything!”, so here you’ll find the context where all your initiatives not only will be heard, but really appreciated!

We're building a large-scale, enterprise-grade web platform on a modular microservice architecture. As a backend engineer, you'll own the full lifecycle of domain services — from data modelling and business logic through API design, messaging contracts, database migrations, and production deployment.

You'll work in a multi-vendor setup alongside DevOps, architecture, and product teams.

Responsibilities

Design, build, test, and operate microservices following a read/write service-pair pattern (read-only delivery APIs + write-capable update/ingestion services)
Implement event-driven communication between services
Own your domain end-to-end: schema design, API contracts, persistence, messaging, and production monitoring
Contribute to shared platform libraries and tooling
Document architectural decisions and service designs for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Required Technical Skills And Experience

C# / .NET 8 – Web API development, modern C# features (records, pattern matching, nullable reference types, async/await best practices)
Entity Framework Core - code-first migrations, specification pattern, repository abstraction
Microservice architecture - clear separation of concerns across layered services (controller → service → repository)
Event-driven messaging - publishing and consuming messages on a service bus (MassTransit, NServiceBus, or similar), contract-first design, idempotency
Entity Framework Core - code-first migrations, specification pattern, repository abstraction
Authentication & Authorization - JWT validation, Azure AD / Entra ID, OIDC
Third-party API integrations (DAM systems, CRM/marketing platforms, email dispatch)

Nice To Have

Azure - AKS (Kubernetes), Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Table Storage, Key Vault, Managed Identity, Azure Functions (isolated worker model), Azure AI Search
Experience with CDN cache invalidation (e.g. Akamai FastPurge API)
Redis caching strategies
Roslyn Analyzers / Code Fix Providers
PDF generation libraries

jobs.title: Architect REQ_105
jobs.description:
Distinguished Tech Innovator

3Pillar warmly extends an invitation for you to join an elite team of visionaries. Beyond software development, we are dedicated to engineering solutions that challenge conventional norms. Envision you: steering projects that redefine urban living, establish new media channels for enterprise companies, or drive innovation in healthcare.

Your invaluable expertise will serve as the cornerstone in shaping the future direction of our endeavors.

This role is the primary technical authority within a client engagement, hands-on across the AI-driven delivery lifecycle (AI-DLC). The Architect owns high-level design choices, dictates technical standards, and stays directly engaged in the codebase — designing and building the architecture that embeds AI agents across the SDLC, from requirements and code generation through testing, documentation, and release. The ideal candidate is as comfortable pairing with an AI agent on a pull request as they are presenting an architecture roadmap to a client executive.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Driven, Agentic Delivery

Design and build the architecture that embeds AI agents across the SDLC — requirements gathering, code generation, testing, documentation, and release management.
Set technical standards for where AI-assisted approaches are trustworthy versus where human-in-the-loop oversight is required to protect quality, compliance, and client trust.
Stay hands-on in the codebase — reviewing, building, and validating AI-driven approaches against real engineering constraints — and feed findings back into 3Pillar's delivery practices.
Assess and plan the insertion of new AI/agentic tooling into existing technology stacks and client environments.

Solution Development & Pre-Sales

Partner with the Solutioning team on pre-SOW technical solutioning — shaping architecture, approach, and feasibility ahead of contract execution.
Translate client requirements into a credible technical narrative and delivery approach, bringing a point of view on where AI-driven delivery accelerates outcomes and where it introduces risk.
Contribute technical input to proposals, estimates, and SOWs, including effort, risk, and architecture tradeoffs.

Architecture & Technical Ownership

Act as the emissary of the architecture — technical owner from design to resolution of tailored solutions on cloud platforms, based on client requirements and constraints.
Partner with stakeholders to determine functional and nonfunctional requirements and business goals for a set of scenarios.
Manage risk identification and mitigation strategies associated with the architecture.
Influence and communicate long-term product vision, technical vision, development strategy, and roadmap.
Contribute to code reviews, documentation, and architectural artifacts.
Design architectures that align with the DevOps culture and QA Automation practices.

Leadership & Mentorship

Active leader in the Architecture Practice community, mentoring engineers through Communities of Practice (CoPs) or on project teams, with a focus on AI-driven delivery skills.
Develop and lead the execution of a technical vision within one or more business or technical domains, with a focus on business value.

Note: 3Pillar operates proprietary delivery frameworks — including our Helix AI human-agent delivery model and our Lightwave Client Engagement SDLC. Candidates will not be expected to know these on day one, but should bring the foundational disciplines and AI-driven, agentic delivery experience that enable rapid adoption.

Minimum Qualifications

A Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field.
5+ years of experience/expertise working as a Software Architect and/or Solutions Architect, with hands-on proficiency in relevant cloud and AI/agentic delivery tooling.
Demonstrated experience embedding AI agents into the SDLC — not just using AI tools, but architecting the integration and the human oversight model that keeps them productive and accountable.
Experience contributing to pre-sales or pre-SOW solutioning — shaping technical approach, scoping, and effort estimation before contracts are signed.
High level of English proficiency required to interact with a globally-based development team.
Communicate in a clear and understandable manner with clients up to the executive level, and be able to articulate the details of the designed architecture using the appropriate level of technical language.
Natural leader with critical reasoning and good decision-making skills.
Extremely good knowledge of SDLC processes and familiarity with actionable metrics and KPIs.
Operational excellence in design methodologies and architectural patterns across multiple platforms.
Ability to work on multiple parallel projects and utilize time management and multitasking skills.
Experience leading Agile software development methodologies.
High-level design proficiency following UML / C4 / ArchiMate.
Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices and tools.
Demonstrate mentorship and thought leadership to engineers and decision-makers throughout the organization.

Additional Experience Desired:

Foundational knowledge in Data Analysis/Modelling/Architecture, ETL Dataflows, and a good understanding of highly scalable distributed and cloud-native data stores.
Experience designing SaaS or highly scalable distributed applications on the cloud.
Financial management experience and ROI calculation.
Solutions Architect certification on a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

What is it like working for 3Pillar Global?

At 3Pillar, We Offer a World Of Opportunity

Imagine a flexible work environment - whether it's the office, your home, or a blend of both. From interviews to onboarding, we embody a remote-first approach.
You will be part of a global team, learning from top talent around the world and across cultures, speaking English everyday. Our global workforce enables our team to leverage global resources to accomplish our work in efficient and effective teams.
We're big on your well-being - as a company, we spend a whole trimester in our annual cycle focused on wellbeing. Whether it is taking advantage of fitness offerings, mental health plans (country-dependent), or simply leveraging generous time off, we want all of our team members operating at their best.
Our professional services model enables us to accelerate career growth and development opportunities - across projects, offerings, and industries.
We are an equal opportunity employer. It goes without saying that we live by values like Intrinsic Dignity and Open Collaboration to create cutting-edge technology AND reinforce our commitment to diversity - globally and locally.

Join us and be a part of a global tech community!

Türkiye’nin en büyük halka açık yazılım ve en büyük yerli iş yazılımı şirketi Logo Yazılım olarak; mikro işletmelerden kurumsal büyük işletmelere kadar farklı ölçekten birçok işletmeye yerli iş yazılımı çözümleri sunuyoruz.

jobs.title: Medior/Senior Back End Developer C# .NET
jobs.description:
Keytrade Bank
is a young and dynamic bank where IT systems were traditionally developed in-house. Today, we are evolving towards a model focused on customer experience and innovation, combining in-house solutions with off-the-shelf products and services for core functionalities.
Where responsibilities used to be organized by technical skills, we now structure them by business domain, called Feature Teams .
Building new products requires close collaboration across back-end, front-end, database, infrastructure, vendors, and service providers.
Working in a smaller bank means broader responsibilities, wider knowledge, and the opportunity to make a real impact. We are growing fast and are looking for motivated people eager to join our teams to help transform and improve our trading and banking systems.
What makes the position interesting?

You will work on a distributed .NET platform built around C# / .NET, Domain-Driven Design and event-driven microservices.
Our services communicate through gRPC and asynchronous messaging using RabbitMQ and NServiceBus, applying patterns such as CQRS, Domain Events, Outbox, etc.
You will be involved not only in development, but also in domain modelling, technical design, architecture decisions and the continuous evolution of our distributed systems.
The platform runs on AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) and uses MySQL/Aurora and DynamoDB, depending on the domain and its access patterns.
We put a strong emphasis on engineering quality, automated testing, observability and production readiness.
Infrastructure and delivery are managed through GitLab CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform.
The role offers the opportunity to work on real-world distributed systems where reliability, scalability, maintainability and domain complexity matter, rather than simply building CRUD applications.
You will not only work with interesting technologies, but also solve complex problems across three key business domains:
Banking
– everything related to payments and banking transactions.
Cards
– debit and credit card ordering and management.
Credits
– primarily our online mortgage product, Keyhome
.

Profile

You are a passionate developer who enjoys:
Being a true team player, sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues, while also being able to drive initiatives autonomously.
Transforming complex business needs into elegant and maintainable technical solutions.
Balancing engineering discipline with pragmatism.
Caring deeply about code quality, security and maintainability.
Continuously learning, both from a technical perspective and about the banking domain.
Participating in technical design, domain modelling, architecture decisions and the evolution of distributed systems.
Working in a Scrum environment.

Our working environment is mainly English-speaking, and you are fluent in English. Dutch and French are considered an asset but are not mandatory.

As an experienced .NET/C# developer, you have solid experience with:
C# / .NET 8/.NET 10
Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
REST API: consuming, designing and building APIs
Messaging/Event-driven architecture: commands, events, asynchronous communication
RabbitMQ
Clean Code and SOLID principles
Microservices architecture
Distributed systems: idempotency, retries, failure handling
Automated testing: unit and integration testing, TDD, xUnit, Moq, AutoFixture
Containerization – Docker
Relational Database, transactions, queries and ORM

We also use these technologies, and we would appreciate if you master them, but if you do not have experience with them, we will help you get up to speed with them:
NServiceBus
Kafka
Amazon Web Services (S3, DynamoDB, KMS, Api Gateway, EKS…)
gRPC/protobuf
OpenTelemetry
Serilog
Dynatrace
Terraform
GitLab CI/CD

Agile way of working
Green surroundings
An inclusive workplace with nice colleagues

De rest? Daar praten we liever over.

Niet: “Hier is één vacature, pas jij erin?”

Dan zien we wel waar het klikt.

Werkomgeving

Het Nationaal Instituut voor Criminalistiek en Criminologie of kortweg het NICC is een federale wetenschappelijke instelling binnen de FOD Justitie. Op vraag van de gerechtelijke overheden verrichten ze onafhankelijk onderzoek.

De directie Criminalistiek identificeert en analyseert sporen van verdachten en modus operandi. Zo helpen we daders van misdrijven op te sporen en bewijslast op te bouwen. De directie Criminologie onderzoekt hoe het strafrechtelijke systeem functioneert en hoe we het kunnen verbeteren.

Taakomschrijving

De persoon zal verantwoordelijk zijn voor het opzetten en ontwikkelen van applicaties voor onze verschillende wetenschappelijke laboratoria. Deze applicaties hebben betrekking op domeinen zoals drugs, toxicologie, ballistiek, DNA-analyse en criminologisch onderzoek. De kandidaat zal zich engageren vanuit een langetermijnperspectief en zal op termijn de back-up worden van ons Head of Development.

De kandidaat zal instaan voor het verzamelen van de behoeften en aanvragen van onze klanten en zal toezien op de correcte naleving van de deadlines van de projecten waarvoor hij/zij verantwoordelijk is.
Hij/zij zal instaan voor het onderhoud van de applicaties en zal daarnaast proactief meedenken en voorstellen formuleren ter ondersteuning van het IT-team.
Hij/zij zal eveneens toezien op de naleving van de vereisten inzake applicatiearchitectuur en veiligheid.
In bepaalde gevallen zal hij/zij externe teams aansturen die ondersteuning bieden bij de uitvoering van de projecten. In dat kader zal de kandidaat, afhankelijk van zijn/haar senioriteitsniveau (meer dan 5 jaar ervaring), ook instaan voor het interviewen en selecteren van externe medewerkers.

Profielomschrijving:

Een ervaren ontwikkelaar die AI gebruikt, moet diepgaande technische expertise combineren met het vermogen om AI-tools te orkestreren, methodologische nauwkeurigheid en geavanceerde ontwerpvaardigheden. De kern van het profiel: een pragmatische architect, prompt engineer, integrator en bewaker van kwaliteit.

Fundamentele technische competenties:

Programmeertalen & frameworks

Beheersing van een moderne backendprogrammeertaal: Python, C#, Java, Go, Node.js.
Beheersing van een frontendframework: React, Vue, Angular. Cloudarchitectuur: Azure, AWS, GCP.
Databases: geavanceerde SQL, optimalisatie, NoSQL, vector databases (Pinecone, Redis Vector).

Architectuur & ontwerp

Moderne design patterns (CQRS, Event Sourcing, Hexagonal Architecture).
Microservices en API's.
Applicatiebeveiliging: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, Zero Trust.
Observability/monitoring: gestructureerde logs, gedistribueerde traces en metrics.

Essentiële AI-competenties:

Geavanceerde prompt engineering

Structureren van prompts (rol → context → beperkingen → outputformaat).
Technieken: chain-of-thought, self-consistency, RAG en prompt guards.
Optimaliseren van de kwaliteit en verminderen van hallucinaties.

Integratie van AI in applicaties

Gebruik van LLM-API's: Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic en Mistral
RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation): vectorisatie, embeddings en pipelines
AI-agents: orkestratie, tools en beveiliging
Fine-tuning: gespecialiseerde modellen en het samenstellen en beheren van datasets

AI-kwaliteit & governance

Evaluatie van modellen (BLEU, ROUGE, perplexity en menselijke evaluatie)
Detectie van bias, robuustheid en conformiteit met regelgeving en standaarden (NIS2, AVG/GDPR)
Implementatie van beveiligings- en controlemechanismen (guardrails, filtering en monitoring)

DevOps- en automatiseringscompetenties

Intelligente automatisering

CI/CD-processen versterkt door AI, zoals het genereren van pipelines, tests en documentatie
AI-ondersteunde refactoring: modernisering van legacycode.
Geautomatiseerde testen: unit tests, integratietesten en mutation testing:

Moderne tools

GitHub Copilot, GitHub en GitLab.
Docker en Kubernetes.

Specifieke competenties van een “AI-augmented” ontwikkelaar

Wat dit profiel werkelijk onderscheidt

Het vermogen om met behulp van AI betrouwbare code te genereren en deze vervolgens te auditen en optimaliseren.
Het creëren van AI-pipelines (prompt → test → verbetering → versionering).
Het gebruik van AI om het ontwerpproces te versnellen, bijvoorbeeld voor diagrammen, modellen en user stories.
Het automatiseren van repetitieve taken, zoals scripts, migraties, testen en documentatie.
Versnelde technologische monitoring: geautomatiseerde samenvattingen en vergelijking van oplossingen.

Wij bieden

Onze federale overheid is volop aan het informatiseren: van cybersecurity-uitdagingen tot digitale communicatie, van netwerkverbeteringen ter ondersteuning van nieuwe manieren van werken tot complexe ontwikkelingsprojecten en optimalisatietrajecten van bestaande applicaties.

Wil je hieraan meewerken en zo een maatschappelijke meerwaarde creëren, terwijl je tegelijk werkt aan je persoonlijke ontwikkeling en maximale kansen krijgt om je ambities waar te maken? Dan bieden wij:

Een duidelijke missie in een stimulerende werkomgeving
Een zeer competitief salarispakket met een uitgebreide waaier aan extralegale voordelen, waaronder:
Hospitalisatieverzekering
Maaltijdcheques

Pensioenfonds

Daarnaast hechten we veel belang aan een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé, met telewerkmogelijkheden voor de meeste functies. Onze kantoren zijn bovendien zeer goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.

This hybrid role combines strategic vision, technical mastery and team leadership to deliver robust, scalable and high-impact AI solutions.

MAIN MISSIONS

You are the Division's technical referent for the definition, design and evolution of artificial intelligence architectures. You play a strategic role in the digital transformation of the organization.
You work closely with different partners to transform operational needs into robust and sustainable technical solutions.
You design reference architectures for artificial intelligence solutions, ensuring that they are seamlessly integrated into the existing IT ecosystem and that security, governance, compliance, performance, and maintainability requirements are met.
You will actively participate in the design, implementation and evolution of the Division's AI-Lab, which will be the reference platform for the development, experimentation and operation of artificial intelligence solutions.
You define the technical architectures for the use of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Large Language Models (LLM), Generative AI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Computer Vision, Speech AI technologies as well as future emerging technologies.
You bring your expertise on cloud, hybrid and on-premise architectures, data platforms, MLOps pipelines, API-oriented architectures, event-driven architectures, containerized environments as well as orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.
You are the guarantor of best practices related to AI Engineering, MLOps, DevSecOps and AI Governance. In particular, you will ensure the integration of cybersecurity, data protection, traceability, auditability, model risk management and regulatory compliance requirements into all the architectures offered.
You collaborate with project managers to assess the technical feasibility of new initiatives, identify risks and ensure the consistency of the solutions developed with the organization's overall IT strategy.
You will constantly monitor technological developments in the artificial intelligence market and evaluate new technologies likely to bring real added value to the organization.

WHAT WE EXPECT

A global architectural vision to design scalable artificial intelligence solutions integrated into the organization's IT ecosystem.
An ability to analyze and synthesize in order to transform complex business needs into pragmatic technical architectures.
Excellent ability to collaborate with a variety of profiles and to federate stakeholders around common solutions.

jobs.title: Software Engineer: Keystone Project (Machine-Verified LLM Inference)
jobs.description:
Mission

The Keystone project, an ARIA-funded collaboration between EPFL and Imperial College London, aims to build a formally-verified ML inference engine, demonstrating that AI can help make verified systems competitive with unverified systems in terms of development effort, features, and performance. Its missions include the design and implementation of verified inference components, the formalization of GPU kernel semantics, the development of AI-assisted proof engineering workflows, and the open-source release of specifications, proofs, and verified artefacts.

We seek an excellent software engineer to play a central role in turning verified research prototypes into a production-grade, high-performance inference engine. Prior experience with formal verification is welcome but not required: a strong systems engineer with the motivation to learn proof-assistant technology will thrive in this role.

Main Duties And Responsibilities

Bring technical expertise in systems programming and performance engineering to support the project’s research; collaborate with the research teams at EPFL and Imperial College London
Design, implement, and maintain core components of the verified LLM inference engine, including the runtime and glue code connecting extracted verified code, GPU kernels, and drivers
Organize and manage the project’s engineering infrastructure: differential testing against reference engines (vLLM, SGLang), continuous integration for code and proofs, and performance benchmarking
Develop and maintain agentic AI pipelines for specification autoformalization, proof generation, and proof repair
Write documentation, procedures, and recommendations to ensure reproducibility of the project’s artefacts
Diagnose, prevent, and repair failures and regressions across the software stack
Analyze the security level and trusted computing base of the components we develop, and contribute to red/blue team exercises within the ARIA programme
Contribute to open-source releases and engage with their user communities

Profile

Higher degree in computer science or education deemed equivalent; experience in the field
Excellent technical knowledge of systems programming, and strong programming ability in several of: Python, C/C++, Rust, OCaml, or other functional languages
Knowledge of one or more of the following, with strong motivation to grow in the others:
GPU programming (CUDA, Triton, PTX) or high-performance computing
ML inference or serving systems (vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch internals, or similar)
Interactive theorem proving (Rocq, Lean, HOL, Isabelle, or similar) or other formal methods

Experience maintaining development tooling: build systems, continuous integration, and test infrastructure
Experience using LLM-based development tools or building agentic workflows is a plus
Mastery of English indispensable (oral and written); French is an asset but not required
Sense of priorities, integrity, and autonomy in your work
Team spirit and aptitude for conducting technical investigations and implementations; excellent ability to communicate with varied audiences, from proof engineers to systems researchers
Strong sense of service and spirit of initiative

We offer

The possibility to join a dynamic and stimulating team on a high-profile ARIA-funded project
A multicultural and academic working environment of high quality
Opportunities for continuing education and professional development
Excellent working conditions
Generous access to frontier AI models and high-performance compute
Funded travel for collaboration between Lausanne and London, and for conferences

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

A brief cover letter (pdf, up to 2 pages).

And In One PDF

A CV, including links to open-source contributions or representative projects where applicable.
Contact details for 3 referees.

For any further information, please contact: Nate Foster (nate.foster@epfl.ch).

More information can be found on https://laser.epfl.ch/.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Sobre el puesto

Buscamos un/a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python) para incorporarse a un proyecto de una compañía internacional líder en soluciones de gestión de nóminas y RRHH. Formarás parte del equipo que desarrolla una plataforma de Payroll Operations potenciada por IA: un asistente inteligente que automatiza los flujos de nómina y permite a los profesionales gestionar sus operaciones a través de una experiencia conversacional.
No es un proyecto greenfield: se espera que te incorpores rápidamente a un codebase grande y existente, entiendas cómo se conectan los sistemas y entregues dentro de los patrones y convenciones ya establecidos. La plataforma cubre todo el stack, desde micro frontends y web components, pasando por APIs REST y bases de datos relacionales, hasta agentes de IA desplegados en cloud, e integra múltiples sistemas de nómina enterprise.
¿Qué harás?

Diseñar, construir y mantener agentes de IA en Python utilizando frameworks agénticos modernos y runtimes de IA en cloud
Desarrollar y mantener APIs en .NET Core que actúan como servicios downstream de la capa de agentes
Construir e integrar micro frontends en Angular y web components en Stencil dentro de una shell application enterprise existente
Trabajar con bases de datos SQL Server: escribir queries, entender esquemas e integrarse con los modelos de datos de nómina existentes
Escribir y mantener código de infraestructura en Terraform para despliegues cloud
Integrar nuevas capacidades de agentes en sistemas legacy de nómina sin romper la funcionalidad existente
Colaborar con equipos de frontend, backend, IA e infraestructura para entregar funcionalidades end-to-end
Aplicar buenas prácticas de seguridad: trust boundaries de identidad, idempotencia, audit trails, redacción de PII y feature flags como kill switches
Contribuir a la documentación de diseño, READMEs y knowledge base del equipo

¿Qué buscamos?

5+ años de experiencia profesional en ingeniería de software, con al menos 2 años en sistemas full-stack (frontend, backend e infraestructura cloud)
IA / Agentes: runtimes de agentes en cloud (despliegue, configuración de memoria, gestión del runtime), frameworks agénticos (diseño de tools, patrones orchestrator/child agent, flujos human-in-the-loop), Model Context Protocol (MCP) en cliente y servidor, prompt engineering y patrones de diseño agénticos (state machines, HITL, intent routing)
Backend: Python 3.10+ a nivel avanzado (async, validación de datos, packaging), .NET Core / C# (APIs REST, implementación de servidores MCP) y SQL Server (esquemas, queries, stored procedures)
Frontend: Angular v15+ (module federation, micro frontends), Stencil.js, TypeScript avanzado y experiencia con design systems enterprise (librerías de componentes, tokens, accesibilidad)
Infraestructura y DevOps: Terraform (container registries, IAM, secrets management), Docker / Podman, AWS (servicios de contenedores, runtimes de IA, secrets, IAM), monorepos (NX o similar) y pipelines CI/CD
Seguridad y compliance: patrones zero-trust e identidad de tenant, diseño idempotente (claves deterministas, exactly-once), audit trails y redacción de PII, feature flags y kill switches

Perfil que encaja

Te pones productivo/a rápido en codebases grandes y desconocidos
Piensas en sistemas: puedes seguir una petición de frontend → API → agente de IA → infraestructura cloud y detectar dónde falla
Te sientes cómodo/a trabajando con sistemas legacy, no solo en proyectos desde cero
Lees antes de escribir: entiendes los patrones existentes antes de introducir nuevos
Autonomía para coger un ticket, encontrar el código relevante y entregar
Colaborador/a de bajo ego, que trabaja dentro de las decisiones arquitectónicas del equipo
Mentalidad de documentación: dejas el codebase mejor de lo que lo encontraste

Se valorará

Conocimiento del dominio de nómina o RRHH (centros de coste, estructuras organizativas, workforce management)
Experiencia con sistemas ERP o CRM enterprise legacy
Testing end-to-end / de integración (Playwright o similar)
Experiencia construyendo o integrando funcionalidades de IA conversacional o chatbots en aplicaciones enterprise
Experiencia integrando funcionalidades basadas en IA/LLMs en sistemas en producción

Nivel de inglés profesional, imprescindible (entorno de trabajo en inglés)
¿Qué ofrecemos?

✅ Horario flexible
✅ Modelo de trabajo híbrido, favoreciendo el equilibrio entre vida personal y profesional
✅ Salario competitivo y plan de retribución flexible
✅ Seguro médico privado
✅ Presupuesto anual para formación y desarrollo profesional
✅ Cursos de idiomas
✅ Participación en comunidades tecnológicas y eventos del sector
✅ Seguimiento continuo y acompañamiento profesional
✅ Plan de desarrollo y crecimiento adaptado a tus objetivos
Sobre nosotros

En InnoIT creemos que el talento se desarrolla en un entorno donde aprender, innovar y disfrutar del camino van de la mano.
🚀 Únete a nuestro equipo, participa en proyectos innovadores y sigue creciendo junto a profesionales apasionados por la tecnología.
Más info:
👉 https://www.inno-it.es/
👉 InnoIT Consulting Barcelona Meetup: https://www.meetup.com/es-ES/Meetup-de-InnoIT-Consulting-en-Barcelona/
👉 InnoIT Consulting Madrid Meetup: https://www.meetup.com/es-ES/meetup-de-innoit-consulting-en-madrid/
Diversidad, Equidad e Inclusión

En InnoIT promovemos activamente la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión. Damos la bienvenida a personas con todo tipo de perfiles, experiencias y trayectorias profesionales, y fomentamos especialmente la participación de colectivos tradicionalmente infrarrepresentados en el sector tecnológico. Evaluamos todas las candidaturas de manera objetiva y justa, garantizando la igualdad de oportunidades durante todo el proceso de selección. Asimismo, nos comprometemos a realizar los ajustes razonables necesarios para asegurar una experiencia accesible e inclusiva.
No discriminamos por razón de género, edad, origen, nacionalidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, religión, discapacidad o cualquier otra condición protegida por la legislación vigente. Trabajamos para construir un entorno laboral diverso, respetuoso e inclusivo, donde todas las personas tengan las mismas oportunidades de crecimiento, desarrollo y reconocimiento profesional.
Si te apasiona construir agentes de IA que transforman procesos enterprise reales y te sentís cómodo/a moviéndote por todo el stack, ¡queremos conocerte!

Excellent C# programming skills and strong knowledge of software engineering best practices.

Job Summary

The Content Division within the Information Technology Department (ITD) is seeking a contractual Systems Engineer to support enterprise content, document management, collaboration, workflow, and knowledge management platforms. The division delivers technology solutions that support content and knowledge management, communications and outreach, member and partner engagement, workflow and authoring capabilities, and selected capital projects within its portfolio.

Under the direction of the Deputy Division Chief or Platform Family Owner, the Systems Engineer will serve as a senior technical contributor for enterprise document management and integrated business applications. The role is primarily focused on hands-on development and support using Microsoft .NET technologies and SharePoint Online as a document management and collaboration platform. Key areas include solution design, application development, workflow automation, API and integration services, metadata-driven document solutions, and operational support. The incumbent will design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable solutions using ASP.NET, C#, SQL Server, REST APIs, SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Platform components, and Microsoft 365 services, while ensuring alignment with business requirements, security standards, and enterprise architecture. The role also includes targeted support for OpenText Content Server / Extended ECM where needed for enterprise content management and integration scenarios.

·    Lead integration design across SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and other business systems, while applying best practices for scalability, supportability, and governance.
·    Provide targeted development and support for OpenText Content Server / Extended ECM, particularly for integrations, content management capabilities, and interoperability with enterprise document repositories.

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Industrial Data & Integration
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

SistelGroup delivers turnkey PLC, SCADA and OT data contextualization solutions for the manufacturing industry. For more than 30 years we have helped pharmaceutical, chemical, and food & beverage manufacturers run plants that are more efficient, safer and fully traceable.
We work as a partner, not a supplier. We learn our customers’ processes, we stay with them through the full life of a solution, and we are the people they call when something matters. That is why our clients stay with us for decades.
When you join us, you will work on international projects with advanced Industry 4.0 and digitalization technologies for leading manufacturing companies. You will also build your career in a group that covers both industrial automation and digital transformation for the manufacturing industry.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Solution Architect to lead the technical direction of our industrial data and integration work. This is a hands-on architecture role, focused on Unified Namespace, industrial connectivity and data contextualization. You will design and build the architectures that connect the plant floor to business systems (SCADA, MES, ERP, warehousing systems, LIMS), and you will write the reference architecture and the standards that our engineers follow. Ignition is a particular focus: it is the platform we build most of these solutions on.
You are hands-on with the technology. You build proofs of concept, prototypes and demonstrations: to prove a design works, to show a client what is possible, and to give our engineers a working reference to learn from. Our project teams carry out the implementation and commissioning, and part of the Solution Architect role is to train them to do it well.
Much of this work is about context. A plant produces millions of values every day, but a value on its own means very little. Context is what turns it into insightful information: which equipment produced it, on which line, during which batch and for which product, and how it connects to the order in the ERP system and the result in the laboratory. You design the models, the naming and the relationships that carry that meaning, so that the same data serves an operator, a quality reviewer and a data scientist without anyone having to guess what it refers to.
You will work with our commercial team from the first client conversations, helping turn a business problem into a design, a demonstration, and a proposal. On projects: you are involved in the early stages — design, architecture and the technical decisions that shape the work — and then hand over to the delivery team. Most of our clients work in regulated industries, which means clear documentation and traceable design decisions are key.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architecture and design

Design Unified Namespace architectures for plant data: namespace and topic structure, information models, and the context that gives each value its meaning.
Design the data models behind the architecture: equipment and site hierarchies, product and batch genealogy, and the relationships between assets, processes and quality results, using recognized models ISA-95 and ISA-88.
Design integrations between plant systems and business systems: PLC, SCADA, ERP, MES, LIMS, historians and data platforms.
Assess legacy plant and laboratory environments and design the modernization path for them.
Choose the technologies, and write reference architecture and design standards for this work.

Proofs of concept and integration

Build proofs of concept, prototypes and reference implementations that prove a design works before a project commits to it.
Build and prove data flows with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Work with Ignition and similar platforms as the plant-side layer of these architectures.
Build prototypes of data-driven applications on top of the architecture: equipment monitoring, predictive maintenance, and batch reporting.
Integrate with ERP and MES using standard message formats such as B2MML, so that production orders, confirmations and quality results flow in both directions.
Make plant data findable and “end user friendly” to people who did not build the system, through consistent naming, documented models and clear metadata.
Connect to business and laboratory systems: SAP and other ERP systems, MES platforms, LIMS and quality systems.

Pre-sales and client consulting

Work with our commercial team during early client conversations: understand the business problem before designing anything.
Run technical workshops with clients, design the solution, and present it clearly to both engineers and management.
Build the demonstrations and solution concepts that our commercial team uses in client meetings.
Contribute to development of technical proposals, solution designs and estimates together with our commercial team.

Technical expertise and knowledge sharing

Train engineers to implement and commission the solutions you design, and build the team’s capability in Ignition, MQTT, industrial data connectivity, and data contextualization concepts.
Lead the design phase of new projects, then hand over to the delivery team with the documentation and guidance they need.

REQUIREMENTS

Degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in industrial automation, industrial software or IT/OT integration, including several years in an architecture or solution design role.
Deep hands-on experience with Ignition (Inductive Automation): you build prototypes and demonstrations yourself, and you are comfortable working in the tools rather than only specifying them.
Proven experience designing and integrating plant-to-enterprise architectures in real production environments: Unified Namespace, PLC, DCS, SCADA, MES, ERP and LIMS.
Strong experience with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA, and REST APIs.
Proven experience modelling and contextualizing industrial data: hierarchies, naming conventions, metadata and the relationships between equipment, process and product.
Strong SQL skills, and at least one scripting language, preferably Python.
Experience delivering in GMP or other regulated environments, with working knowledge of GAMP 5, EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11.
The ability to explain a complex architecture simply, to engineers and to managers.
Commercial skills: effort estimation, and technical workshop facilitation.
English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus.

DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE AND CERTIFICATIONS

The following skills are nice-to-have and will support the innovative engineering initiatives at our company.
Data-driven manufacturing applications: predictive maintenance, equipment monitoring, OEE, energy monitoring solutions, batch reporting and yield, golden batch.
MQTT broker platforms: HiveMQ, or the Cirrus Link modules for Ignition.
Cloud knowledge, preferably Azure.
Historians and industrial data platforms: AVEVA OSI PI, AspenTech Inmation, or similar.
Time-series and non-relational databases (MongoDB, InfluxDB, or similar).
Containers, CI/CD and version control (Docker, Kubernetes, Git).
Data analysis and dashboards (Power BI, Grafana or similar).
OT network and security design: segmentation, industrial DMZ, and ISA/IEC 62443 knowledge or certification.
MES platforms: Ignition Sepasoft, Körber PAS-X, Siemens Opcenter, or similar.
Multi-site standardization, or defining a technical service offering: creating a reference architecture or data model template and rolling it out across several plants or projects.
Regulatory awareness for industrial data: the EU GMP Annex 11 revision, and Annex 22 on artificial intelligence in GMP.

WHAT WE OFFER

Company Overview

Mendix is on a mission to fundamentally reinvent the way applications are created by abstracting the process and enabling everyone who has a stake in an enterprise's digital future—business people and analysts, web developers, software engineers, even CEOs—to meaningfully participate, thereby creating better applications faster. Our goal is simply to create the future of software development.

Position Overview

Join our R&D team and help shape the future of low-code application development. As a Mendix Developer, you'll work with the latest technologies—React, Node.js, TypeScript, AWS, C#, and more—to build and improve our innovative platform. Your work will directly impact more than 40,000 developers from 4,000 organizations worldwide, influencing millions of end users globally.

You'll become a deeper expert in Mendix technology, contribute to defining our product roadmap, and tackle technical challenges with innovative solutions. If you're passionate about technology, thrive in collaborative environments, and want to make a real difference, this is your opportunity to grow with us.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and enhance features for the Mendix platform using modern technologies and best practices
Contribute to the technical roadmap and drive innovation within our product
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement solutions that improve developer experience
Solve complex technical challenges with creative, pragmatic approaches
Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing to elevate team capabilities
Help shape the future of low-code development through your expertise and insights

Qualifications

Experience working with the Mendix Platform or similar low-code development environments
Proficiency in languages such as Java, C#, Python, or TypeScript
Proven experience working in Agile development environments
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a passion for technology
Demonstrated ability to continuously improve yourself and your work
Collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Our Benefits & Rewards

The salary range for this position is €52,100 to €78,200 and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the SIEMENS Benefit link .

Our Culture

Experience a relaxed, innovative environment where your skills and ideas are valued. You'll enjoy monthly crafting days to explore side projects and try new technologies, with a dedicated individual budget for conference attendance. Teams are autonomous and empowered to drive innovation that contributes to our bigger vision.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

new_jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

At TOPIC, we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you the driven and ambitious Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)who enjoys writing production-quality code to automate testing of complex embedded systems that we are looking for?

“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."

Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer

What will you do as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)?

As an Software Development Engineer in Test, you operate at the intersection of software development and quality engineering. You design and build high-quality test infrastructure and automation in the same way developers build production systems. With your strong programming skills in C++and/or Python, you ensure software is testable, scalable, and reliable by design. You work closely with software engineers on complex high-tech systems, contributing directly to codebases, test architecture, and continuous integration pipelines. Rather than only validating software, you actively shape how it is built and verified.

Your responsibilities as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET):

Design, develop, and maintain test frameworks and automation tooling using C++ and/or Python
Contribute to production code and testability improvements in collaboration with software engineers
Develop automated tests across multiple levels (unit, integration, system) as part of the development process
Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines and test infrastructure to enable fast and reliable feedback
Analyze complex systems and failures, and trace issues to root cause in code
Drive testability, observability, and quality-by-design principles within development teams
Work on high-tech systems (embedded / hardware-software integration / distributed systems) with real-world impact
Take ownership of technical decisions around test architecture and tooling
Continuously improve automation strategy with a strong focus on engineering scalability and maintainability

Job Requirements

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

Challenging and interesting projects in different domains
Benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues
Focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions
Annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy
Tech events and knowledge sessions

This will make you better:

Permanent contract
An all-in employment package between €57,000 and €76.000 (including net expense allowance, mobility package, 13th-month bonus, and holiday allowance). Final salary is based on relevant work experience and level of expertise
26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget (when you relocate to the Netherlands)

This will keep you healthy:

A good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working
An inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym
The home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment
Lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks

What do you bring as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)?

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar
5 years of work experience in the high‑tech domain
Experience with programming in Python, C++ and/or C# and familiar with applying OO principles.
Hands‑on experience with test automation
Preferably experience with the ROBOT Framework and methodologies such as TDD, BDD, keyword‑driven testing, data‑driven testing, model‑based testing, and property‑based testing
You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive
A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

new_jobs.title: Senior Back-end Developer
new_jobs.description:
Bij BproCare, onderdeel van Esprit ICT Groep, delen we alles: kennis, ervaring, uitdagingen én successen.

Hier bouw je niet zomaar software. Je bouwt mee aan een platform dat levens verandert.

Aan de slag als Senior Back-end Developer

Bij BproCare hebben we twee zorgplatformen:
ATC Platform
: ontwikkeld voor verzorgings- en verpleeghuizen.
HomeCare Platform
: speciaal ontwikkeld voor de thuiszorg.

Beide platformen zijn gericht op het ondersteunen van zorgverleners en mantelzorgers in een effectievere en meer mensgerichte werkwijze.

Ons doel is eenvoudig: met behulp van onze zorgcommunicatieplatformen de regie teruggeven aan zowel zorgvragers als zorgverleners.

Als Senior Back-end Developer
bij BproCare speel je een belangrijke rol in het ontwikkelen, implementeren en onderhouden van onze platformen, met de focus op het HomeCare Platform
. Je zorgt ervoor dat de achterliggende systemen optimaal functioneren, data veilig en efficiënt wordt verwerkt en ons platform schaalbaar, betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig blijft.

Wij zoeken

Een specialist met gedegen kennis en ervaring in AWS
en Java
, die ons helpt bij het verder ontwikkelen van een hoog schaalbare en hoog beschikbare thuiszorgapplicatie.
Ons applicatielandschap bestaat onder andere uit de volgende componenten en technologieën:
Amazon SQS
Amazon SNS
Amazon EventBridge
Amazon Cognito
Amazon API Gateway
AWS Lambda
Quarkus
DynamoDB
PostgreSQL
GitLab (codebeheer en CI/CD-pipelines)
AWS CDK (Infrastructure as Code)

Uiteraard zoeken we het schaap met de vijf poten. Iemand die niet alleen sterk is in de technologie, maar ook een uitstekende software engineer is. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan ontvangen we graag je reactie!

What's in it for me?

Een passend salaris op basis van kennis en ervaring.
25 vakantiedagen op basis van een 40-urige werkweek.
Een pensioenregeling waarbij BproCare twee derde van de premie voor haar rekening neemt.
Uitstekende opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden gericht op vakmanschap en persoonlijke groei.
Regelmatig gezellige borrels, gezamenlijke lunches en leuke teamuitjes.

Nog even over je team

Een van de grootste krachten van BproCare is dat we ons werk met plezier en passie uitvoeren. We houden van openheid, korte lijnen en persoonlijke betrokkenheid.
Met onze enthousiaste medewerkers vormen we een hecht team dat altijd voor elkaar klaarstaat. Onze klanten merken dat elke dag en waarderen ons regelmatig om de positieve uitstraling van onze collega's.

Werken bij BproCare gaat daarom verder dan alleen een baan.
Daarnaast maken we onderdeel uit van Esprit ICT Groep
, een organisatie met ruim 700 medewerkers
, verdeeld over verschillende locaties in Nederland.
Je komt terecht in het R&D-team
, onder leiding van Jasper
. Het team bestaat uit acht collega's, voornamelijk developers, met een mooie mix van leeftijden, ervaring en achtergronden.
Op dinsdag en donderdag
werken we met het hele team vanuit ons kantoor in Apeldoorn
. Op de overige dagen kijken we wat het beste past bij het werk en het team, maar werken we vaak efficiënt vanuit huis.

new_jobs.title: Backend Engineer (.NET) (f/m/d)
new_jobs.description:
Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform, powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Our modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, backed by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

We're looking for a Mid-Level Backend Engineer
to join our Invoice & Tax team. This is where hospitality meets regulation: every property Apaleo powers needs to invoice correctly and handle tax right, in every country it operates in. If you like the idea of solving real compliance problems with clean, well-tested code, and owning your work end to end, read on.

What You'll Be Up To

Own backend projects end to end: from validating requirements with the product manager, through architecture and technical breakdown, to implementation and release.
Build and extend backend services using .NET 10, running in Docker containers.
Develop features from database design through business logic to RESTful APIs, with a direct line to how tax and invoicing rules across multiple countries shape the implementation.
Write clean, well-tested code, including unit and end-to-end tests. We don't have a dedicated QA function, so you'll take full ownership of making sure what you ship holds up in production.
Monitor your own services in production, and identify and resolve issues early.
Work against dual deadlines on invoicing and tax, driven by regulatory requirements as well as customer commitments, and escalate early when something's at risk.
Collaborate closely with your product manager, frontend engineers and other backend engineers in an agile team where your ideas and feedback are valued.

What You'll Bring to the Team

A degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Solid, independent experience delivering backend features end to end in a cloud environment.
Strong .NET / C# backend development experience.
A genuine tolerance for tax, legal and compliance subject matter. You don't need deep expertise from day one, but multi-country tax and invoicing legislation is core to this role, not a side detail, so it needs to hold your interest.
A meticulous, detail-driven working style. Compliance work leaves little room for loose ends.
A proactive approach to communication: comfortable clarifying requirements, flagging risk and escalating early rather than waiting to be asked.
Hands-on experience with at least some of the following:
Relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
Docker and containerised workflows.
Cloud platforms such as AWS (Azure experience is also welcome) and message-based or asynchronous systems, such as Kafka or Azure Service Bus.
Familiarity with microservices concepts and API-driven architecture.
Comfort breaking down tasks, estimating work and delivering features incrementally.
Experience with, or interest in, AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or similiar.
Fluent English.

Nice to have

First experience with Kafka or other streaming / messaging systems.
Exposure to Kubernetes / ECS or cloud-native DevOps practices.
Basic experience with performance tuning or database optimizations.
Experience working in SaaS or API-first products.

Good to know before you apply

A little more context on the domain and the team, so you know what you're stepping into.

This role sits in a compliance-heavy space. Much of the implementation work is shaped by how different countries legislate tax and invoicing, so this is genuinely interesting problem-solving territory if that kind of depth appeals to you.
Invoice & Tax is also central to how Apaleo grows: as we expand into new markets, this team drives the discovery and requirements work that makes sure our platform is ready to operate there. You'll have a direct hand in shaping how Apaleo enters new countries.
The team is growing and evolving, including a move from Scrum to a Kanban way of working.

What We Offer

Culture & Growth

A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle

Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket.
Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo:
Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role, it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (C#)
new_jobs.description:
A well-established European technology company developing cloud-based platforms for business customers is looking for a Senior .NET Engineer to join its product engineering team.
This is a hands-on senior development role with an interesting additional dimension: AI agents are already integrated into the software development workflow. The successful candidate will combine traditional software engineering with modern AI-assisted development, helping structure work for both engineers and coding agents.
What You'll Be Doing
• Design and develop new features for a cloud-based B2B platform.
• Work primarily with C# and modern .NET technologies.
• Translate product and business requirements into clear technical solutions.
• Structure development tasks for both human developers and AI coding agents.
• Use and improve AI-assisted engineering workflows.
• Review code and validate AI-generated development output.
• Maintain high standards through testing, code review and technical verification.
• Help prioritise development work and coordinate releases.
• Work with product and other stakeholders to ensure technical delivery remains aligned with business priorities.
What We're Looking For
• Strong professional experience with C# / .NET.
• Previous exposure to AI-assisted software engineering, coding agents or agentic development workflows.
• Ability to break complex requirements into clearly defined technical tasks.
• Experience working within agile software development teams.
• Strong understanding of software quality, testing and maintainable architecture.
• Comfortable combining hands-on engineering with coordination and technical ownership.
• Very good German and English language skills.
Experience in any of the following: Microsoft Azure, Cloud-native systems, SaaS platforms, Multi-tenant applications, Microsoft 365 or Entra ID, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, MCP servers.
Working Environment
This is a permanent hybrid position in Germany, with 3 days per week in the office.
Candidates can work from one of two offices in the Frankfurt/Hesse region.

Apply

Role overview

We are looking for a talented and adaptable Application Engineer to join our Business Systems team. This is a T-shaped role: you will bring deep technical expertise in at least one discipline that is of direct value to the team (AIS and REST APIs, SQL, Power Platform or Fabric), and combine it with the breadth and curiosity to act as a technical product owner across a defined portfolio of business-critical applications.

You will be comfortable talking to a range of people and translating technical ideas for non-technical audiences. You will work closely with business users, technology colleagues and third-party vendors to ensure your portfolio of applications remains reliable, scalable, secure and aligned to the firm's evolving needs. This will require strong troubleshooting skills and a solid understanding of system integrations, data structures and flows, and application architecture, as well as practical experience of managing the operational health of applications, including application configuration, patching and upgrade management. This is an excellent opportunity to help shape and improve our technology landscape, enhance operational efficiency, and drive digital and cloud transformation.

We are a close-knit and supportive team of 15 people, dedicated to sharing knowledge and cross-skilling to support and improve the diverse set of business-critical applications we look after. We are more interested in the quality of your technical thinking and your track record as a developer and product owner than in the specific languages you have coded in or the products you have previously managed. Above all, we are looking for someone with the flexibility and appetite to pick up new technologies and take ownership of whatever tools and platforms the role requires, which will include:

Application Portfolios

It is likely that the successful candidate will initially take joint ownership of one of the following application portfolios, dependent on their background and the team's priorities at the time of joining.

Document Management

Products in the portfolio include: iManage products (Work, SPM, IRM and RAVN), SharePoint and HighQ

Finance

Products in the portfolio include: Elite 3E, OneAdvanced Time Capture (Carpe Diem), Emburse (expenses management) and payroll systems

Key responsibilities

The key responsibilities of this role are set out below and there may be others which are not listed. You may be required on occasion to work outside our normal working hours of 9:30am to 5:30pm.

Technical Product Ownership

Serve as the technical product owner for assigned business applications, managing their technical direction and ensuring alignment with the Technology department’s roadmap, business strategy and user needs.
Stay informed of product updates, upgrades and roadmap developments and manage their implementation.
Maintain and prioritise the product backlog, including new features, upgrades, maintenance tasks, defect resolution and security updates.
Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for your portfolio, promoting optimal use of the applications and proactively identifying opportunities for business improvement.
Engage regularly with application stakeholders and users to ensure they are informed of progress and change, and to monitor and improve user experience.

Design and Development

Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into practical application changes or enhancements.
Work with internal and external teams to securely design, develop, test and optimise enhancements to your assigned applications.
Participate in or lead agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog refinement and retrospectives.

Application Management and Support

Manage the configuration, deployment and ongoing support of your portfolio of applications.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, escalating to vendors where necessary.
Act as the primary liaison between internal users, procurement, support teams and vendors for your portfolio.
Manage vendor relationships, including coordinating support cases, overseeing service levels, and negotiating enhancements or customisations.
Monitor usage and performance, proactively addressing issues and identifying opportunities for improvement.
Maintain thorough documentation relating to change control, configuration, processes and procedures.

Cybersecurity and Risk

Maintain best practice security policies and procedures for the applications, any data they handle or store and their integrations, complying with internal and external security standards.
Identify and manage risks and vulnerabilities in your portfolio and in its roadmap, and proactively support their mitigation.
Participate in audits, risk assessments and business continuity planning as it relates to your application portfolio.

Candidate profile

Candidates for this position must have:

Essential:

Proven experience of managing and supporting business-critical applications in a complex professional services, or similarly demanding, environment.
Deep technical expertise in at least one discipline directly applicable to the team: Azure Integration Services and REST APIs, SQL, Power Platform or Fabric.
Strong troubleshooting skills and a solid understanding of system integrations, data structures and flows, and application architecture.
Experience with application configuration, patching and upgrade management.
Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and documentation skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
A collaborative approach and a genuine enjoyment of working as part of a close-knit team.
Adaptability and a willingness to learn new skills and ways of working and to take on additional responsibilities as the team's needs evolve.

Desirable:
